model.name: Construction
model.description: Construction is a global engineering and building industry delivering large-scale infrastructure, energy, and commercial projects including highways, airports, bridges, power plants, and residential developments.

model.data_domains: Project, Contract, Workforce, Equipment, Materials, Procurement, Finance, Safety, Quality, Design, Scheduling, Client, Subcontractor, Site Operations, Document Management

domains.name: project
domains.description: Core SSOT for all construction project lifecycle data from NTP through commissioning and handover. Owns project identity, WBS (Work Breakdown Structure), milestones, baseline scope, EVM metrics (CPI, SPI), deliverables, and project performance tracking. Central to EPC (Engineering Procurement Construction) execution and PMO (Project Management Office) governance across DB, DBB, and PPP delivery models.

products.name: construction_project
products.description: Core master entity representing a construction project from NTP (Notice to Proceed) through commissioning and handover. Owns project identity, delivery model (EPC, DB, DBB, PPP, BOT), project type (infrastructure, commercial, residential, energy, industrial), contract value, project status, geographic location, client reference, PMO classification, project type classification (typical duration/value ranges, required certifications, sector), and key lifecycle dates. SSOT for all project-level identity, metadata, and classification across the enterprise.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a construction project record in the enterprise data platform. Primary key for the construction_project master entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client organisation that commissioned this project. Links to the client master entity for contract owner identification.

attributes.name: client_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_opportunity. Business justification: Bid-to-project conversion traceability is a core CRM and commercial reporting requirement. Linking a construction project back to the client opportunity it was won from enables win-rate analysis, pipe

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Every construction project is executed under a specific legal entity (company code) for contract execution, tax reporting, and financial consolidation. This is a fundamental SAP PS relationship. Enabl

attributes.name: framework_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_framework_agreement. Business justification: Many construction projects are awarded under framework agreements. Tracking which framework agreement governs a project is essential for framework utilisation reporting, ceiling value monitoring, call

attributes.name: main_contractor_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Main EPC contractor assignment for each project; required for contract management, reporting, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: primary_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.contact. Business justification: Required for Project Communication Plan to identify primary client contact for status reports and issue escalation.

attributes.name: rfp_issuance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.rfp_issuance. Business justification: RFP-to-project traceability is essential for procurement compliance reporting and bid performance analysis. Linking the awarded project to the originating RFP issuance enables contract value vs. estim

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the project achieved practical completion and was formally handed over to the client. Triggers the start of the DLP (Defects Liability Period) and final account settlement.
attributes.references: FIDIC – Taking Over Certificate; ISO 9001 – Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which physical construction activities actually commenced on site. Recorded in Oracle Primavera P6 and Procore daily logs. May differ from NTP date due to mobilisation periods.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Actual Start; Procore – Daily Log

attributes.name: approved_budget
attributes.description: Total approved project budget including all cost codes, contingency, and approved change orders (CO). Used as the control budget for EVM (Earned Value Management) and cost performance index (CPI) calculations in SAP S/4HANA Project Systems.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 – Revenue from Contracts; SAP S/4HANA – Project Budgeting (PS-BD)

attributes.name: bid_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the original bid or tender submission (RFP/RFQ) from which this project was awarded. Links project execution back to the pre-award opportunity in Salesforce CRM for win/loss analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM – Opportunity/Bid Management; RFP (Request for Proposal) Process

attributes.name: bim_model_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the primary BIM (Building Information Modeling) model associated with this project in Autodesk BIM 360. Enables traceability between the project master record and the 3D design model for clash detection and document control.
attributes.references: Autodesk BIM 360 – Model Management; ISO 19650 – BIM Information Management

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the project site is located. Used for logistics planning, local regulatory compliance, and geographic analytics.

attributes.name: contract_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the contract value and all financial reporting on this project (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AED).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 – Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP – Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Formal contract reference number as issued by the client or legal department. Used for contract administration, correspondence tracking in Aconex, and legal reference in all formal project documentation.
attributes.references: FIDIC – General Conditions of Contract; Aconex – Document Management

attributes.name: contract_value
attributes.description: Original awarded contract value in the project currency as defined in the contract agreement. Baseline financial figure for budget control, EVM (Earned Value Management) calculations, and P&L (Profit and Loss) reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 – Revenue from Contracts with Customers; FIDIC – General Conditions of Contract

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country in which the project is physically located (e.g., USA, GBR, ARE, AUS). Used for regulatory compliance, HSE jurisdiction, and geographic reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 – Country Codes; OSHA – Jurisdictional Compliance

attributes.name: cpi
attributes.description: EVM (Earned Value Management) Cost Performance Index (CPI) calculated as Earned Value divided by Actual Cost. A CPI below 1.0 indicates cost overrun. Updated monthly from SAP S/4HANA Project Systems and Oracle Primavera P6 progress data.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK – Earned Value Management; SAP S/4HANA – Project Information System

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the construction project record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record management compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 – Quality Management Systems; GDPR – Data Management

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: Contractual and organisational delivery model under which the project is executed. EPC (Engineering Procurement Construction), DB (Design-Build), DBB (Design-Bid-Build), PPP (Public-Private Partnership), BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer), GMP (Guaranteed Maximum Price), JV (Joint Venture). Determines risk allocation, procurement strategy, and governance structure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EPC|DB|DBB|PPP|BOT|GMP|JV — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FIDIC – Suite of Contracts; IBC – International Building Code Council

attributes.name: dlp_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Defects Liability Period (DLP) expires, after which the contractor's obligation to rectify defects at no cost to the client ceases. Calculated from actual completion date plus the contractual DLP duration.
attributes.references: FIDIC – Defects Liability Period Clause; ISO 9001 – Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: forecast_completion_date
attributes.description: Current forecast date for project completion based on latest schedule update and progress data from Oracle Primavera P6. Reflects approved EOT (Extension of Time) claims and current schedule performance.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Forecast Finish; FIDIC – Extension of Time Clause

attributes.name: hse_risk_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: HSE (Health Safety and Environment) Risk Level
attributes.description: Overall HSE (Health Safety and Environment) risk classification for the project based on project type, location, scope complexity, and hazard profile. Determines the level of HSE oversight, inspection frequency, and SWMS (Safe Work Method Statement) requirements as managed in Intelex.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 – Occupational Health and Safety; OSHA – Risk Assessment Standards; Intelex – HSE Management

attributes.name: is_joint_venture
attributes.description: Indicates whether this project is being executed under a Joint Venture (JV) arrangement with one or more partner organisations. Affects financial consolidation, risk sharing, and governance reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 11 – Joint Arrangements; FIDIC – Joint Venture Provisions

attributes.name: jv_partner_share_pct
attributes.description: The company's ownership or participation percentage in the Joint Venture (JV) arrangement for this project. Used for financial consolidation, P&L (Profit and Loss) attribution, and EBITDA reporting. Null when is_joint_venture is False.
attributes.references: IFRS 11 – Joint Arrangements; GAAP – Proportionate Consolidation

attributes.name: leed_certification_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) Certification Target
attributes.description: Target LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification level for the project as specified in the contract or client sustainability requirements. Drives design decisions, material procurement, and commissioning activities.
attributes.references: LEED – U.S. Green Building Council Rating System; ISO 14001 – Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_rate
attributes.description: Contractual daily rate of Liquidated Damages (LD) payable to the client for each day of delay beyond the planned completion date. Critical for financial risk exposure calculation and schedule management prioritisation.
attributes.references: FIDIC – Liquidated Damages Clause; IFRS 15 – Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: ntp_date
attributes.description: Official date on which the Notice to Proceed (NTP) was issued by the client, authorising the contractor to commence construction activities. Marks the formal start of the project execution phase and is the baseline for schedule calculations in Oracle Primavera P6.
attributes.references: FIDIC – General Conditions of Contract; Oracle Primavera P6 – Project Start Date

attributes.name: physical_progress_pct
attributes.description: Overall physical percentage completion of the project as reported in the latest progress update from Oracle Primavera P6 and HCSS HeavyJob. Used for earned value calculations, client progress billing, and PMO dashboard reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Activity Percent Complete; HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Baseline planned completion date for the project as defined in the contract and approved schedule. Used for schedule variance analysis, LD (Liquidated Damages) exposure calculation, and EOT (Extension of Time) claim management.
attributes.references: FIDIC – General Conditions of Contract; Oracle Primavera P6 – Baseline Finish Date

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Baseline planned start date for project execution as established in the approved project schedule in Oracle Primavera P6. Used for SPI (Schedule Performance Index) variance analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Baseline Start Date; ASCE – Project Scheduling Standards

attributes.name: pmo_classification
attributes.description: PMO (Project Management Office) tier classification that determines the level of governance, reporting frequency, and executive oversight applied to the project. Tier 1 projects receive the highest level of PMO scrutiny.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Framework – Project Classification Policy

attributes.name: primavera_project_reference
attributes.description: Native project identifier in Oracle Primavera P6 scheduling system. Used for cross-system data integration between the enterprise data platform and the scheduling system of record for activity, resource, and baseline data.

attributes.name: procore_project_reference
attributes.description: Native project identifier in Procore construction management platform. Used for cross-system integration to retrieve daily logs, RFIs (Requests for Information), submittals, change orders, and drawing management data.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric project identifier used across Oracle Primavera P6, SAP S/4HANA Project Systems, and Procore. Serves as the cross-system business key for project identification in all operational and financial systems.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Project Code; SAP S/4HANA – Project Definition (PS)

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the construction project as agreed with the client and used in all formal correspondence, contracts, and reporting.
attributes.references: FIDIC – General Conditions of Contract; Procore – Project Setup

attributes.name: project_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the construction project from prospect through to completion or cancellation. Drives PMO governance workflows and financial reporting eligibility.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Project Status; SAP S/4HANA – Project System Status

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the construction project by sector or asset class. Determines applicable standards, certification requirements, and typical duration/value benchmarks used in PMO reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: infrastructure|commercial|residential|energy|industrial|transport|water|healthcare|education|mixed_use — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IBC – International Building Code; ASCE – American Society of Civil Engineers

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Internal geographic region or business unit region where the project is located (e.g., North America, Middle East, Asia Pacific, Europe). Used for PMO regional portfolio reporting and resource allocation.

attributes.name: retention_pct
attributes.description: Contractual retention percentage withheld by the client from each progress payment certificate. Typically released in two tranches: at practical completion and at DLP (Defects Liability Period) expiry. Used in cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: FIDIC – Retention Money Clause; IFRS 15 – Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: sap_project_definition
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems project definition code (PS-DEF) that serves as the root WBS element for all cost postings, purchase orders, and financial transactions related to this project in the ERP system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA – Project Systems (PS) Module; IFRS/GAAP – Financial Reporting

attributes.name: site_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the primary project site in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for GIS (Geographic Information System) mapping, logistics routing, and environmental impact assessments.
attributes.references: GIS – WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; ISO 6709 – Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: site_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the primary project site in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for GIS (Geographic Information System) mapping, logistics routing, and environmental impact assessments.
attributes.references: GIS – WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; ISO 6709 – Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: spi
attributes.description: EVM (Earned Value Management) Schedule Performance Index (SPI) calculated as Earned Value divided by Planned Value. An SPI below 1.0 indicates schedule delay. Updated monthly from Oracle Primavera P6 progress reporting.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK – Earned Value Management; Oracle Primavera P6 – Schedule Performance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the construction project record in the enterprise data platform. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 – Quality Management Systems; GDPR – Data Management

attributes.name: wbs_code
attributes.description: Top-level WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) code assigned to this project in Oracle Primavera P6 and SAP S/4HANA Project Systems. Serves as the hierarchical cost and schedule control framework root for all project activities.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – WBS; SAP S/4HANA – WBS Element (PS-WBS); PMI PMBOK

products.name: wbs_element
products.description: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) node representing a decomposed scope element within a construction project. Captures WBS code, level, parent-child hierarchy, scope description, responsible discipline, budgeted cost, planned quantity, unit of measure, and WBS type (summary, work package, control account). Supports EVM (Earned Value Management) rollup and cost control at granular scope levels.
products.reference: WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) — PMI PMBOK / Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the WBS element record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Guide – WBS Standard; Oracle Primavera P6 WBS Object

attributes.name: assigned_warehouse_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to material.warehouse. Business justification: Supports Site Staging Plan linking each WBS element to its dedicated staging warehouse.

attributes.name: bim_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.bim_model. Business justification: BIM coordination process requires each WBS element to reference its BIM model for clash detection and model federation; experts expect this link.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent construction project to which this WBS element belongs. Links the WBS node to its project context for EVM rollup and PMO governance.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Project Object; SAP PS Project Definition

attributes.name: finance_cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Required for cost‑coding WBS elements in EVM and budget reports; experts assign a cost code to each WBS element for financial tracking.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to material.material_master. Business justification: Needed for WBS Cost Estimation to identify the primary material type for each work package.

attributes.name: parent_wbs_element_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Parent Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) Element ID
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediate parent WBS node, enabling hierarchical decomposition of project scope. Null for root-level WBS elements.
attributes.references: PMI Practice Standard for Work Breakdown Structures; Oracle Primavera P6 WBS Hierarchy

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_permit. Business justification: Specific WBS work packages (excavation, electrical, structural) are gated by individual permits. Permit-gated work scheduling and construction readiness checks require linking WBS elements to their re

attributes.name: phase_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.phase. Business justification: WBS elements are scoped within project phases (e.g., civil works WBS elements belong to construction phase, commissioning WBS elements belong to commissioning phase). Adding phase_id FK enables phase-

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.site. Business justification: WBS elements are physically located at sites. WBS-to-site mapping drives cost allocation, resource planning, and site-level schedule reporting. A project controls engineer expects WBS elements to be t

attributes.name: wbs_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.wbs_node. Business justification: Required for integrated Earned Value reporting aligning cost WBS with schedule hierarchy; project managers need to map WBS elements to schedule nodes.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Total actual costs incurred to date for this WBS element, sourced from SAP S/4HANA job costing and Viewpoint Vista. Used as the ACWP input in EVM calculations.
attributes.references: PMI Practice Standard for Earned Value Management; SAP PS – Actual Costs; IFRS 15

attributes.name: actual_finish_date
attributes.description: Date on which work on this WBS element was physically completed, as recorded in Oracle Primavera P6. Null if work is still in progress. Used for schedule performance reporting and DLP (Defects Liability Period) trigger.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Actual Finish; PMI PMBOK – Schedule Control; FIDIC Clause 11

attributes.name: actual_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of work completed and installed to date for this WBS element, as recorded in HCSS HeavyJob field production tracking. Compared against planned_quantity for production performance analysis.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking; AACE RP 10S-90

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which work on this WBS element actually commenced on site, as recorded in Oracle Primavera P6 or Procore daily logs. Used to calculate schedule variance and Extension of Time (EOT) claims.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Actual Start; Procore Daily Log; FIDIC Clause 8

attributes.name: approved_budget_changes
attributes.description: Cumulative value of approved Change Orders (CO) that have modified the original budget for this WBS element. Reconciles original_budget_cost to budgeted_cost.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 13 – Variations; Procore Change Order Management; AACE RP 10S-90

attributes.name: boq_item_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or code linking this WBS element to the corresponding Bill of Quantities (BOQ) line item in the contract. Enables traceability between scope decomposition and contract pricing.
attributes.references: FIDIC – Bill of Quantities; NRM2 (RICS New Rules of Measurement); ASCE Quantity Surveying

attributes.name: budgeted_cost
attributes.description: Total approved budget allocated to this WBS element, representing the Budget at Completion (BAC) for EVM purposes. Expressed in the project currency. Forms the baseline for CPI and SPI calculations.
attributes.references: AACE International – Earned Value Management; PMI Practice Standard for EVM; IFRS 15 – Revenue from Contracts

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classification of costs associated with this WBS element: direct (billable to project scope), indirect (overhead allocation), overhead, contingency (risk reserve), or provisional (BOQ provisional sum). Affects cost reporting and contract billing.
attributes.references: AACE International RP 10S-90; FIDIC – Provisional Sums; SAP PS Cost Classification

attributes.name: cost_account_code
attributes.description: Cost account or cost code assigned to this WBS element for job costing and financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA and Viewpoint Vista. Maps WBS scope to the chart of accounts for P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PS – Cost Element; Viewpoint Vista – Job Cost Code; AACE RP 10S-90

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this WBS element record was first created in the source system or lakehouse. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 – Date and Time Formats; GDPR Article 5 – Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: csi_division_code
attributes.description: CSI MasterFormat division code classifying the type of construction work for this WBS element (e.g., 03 = Concrete, 05 = Metals, 26 = Electrical). Enables industry-standard scope classification and benchmarking.
attributes.references: CSI MasterFormat – Construction Specifications Institute; IBC – International Building Code

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values on this WBS element (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AED). Supports multi-currency EPC projects and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 – Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: Contract delivery model under which this WBS element is executed: EPC (Engineering Procurement Construction), DB (Design-Build), DBB (Design-Bid-Build), PPP (Public-Private Partnership), BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer), or GMP (Guaranteed Maximum Price). Affects cost control and contract administration rules.
attributes.references: FIDIC Conditions of Contract; PMI PMBOK – Project Procurement Management

attributes.name: earned_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earned Value (EV) – Budgeted Cost of Work Performed (BCWP)
attributes.description: Budgeted cost of work actually performed to date for this WBS element (BCWP). Calculated as percent_complete multiplied by budgeted_cost. Core EVM metric used to derive CPI and SPI at the WBS level.
attributes.references: PMI Practice Standard for Earned Value Management; AACE International RP 11R-88; Oracle Primavera P6 – Earned Value

attributes.name: evm_enabled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this WBS element is included in the project's EVM (Earned Value Management) performance measurement baseline. Summary and planning package nodes may be excluded from direct EVM measurement.
attributes.references: PMI Practice Standard for Earned Value Management; AACE RP 11R-88; Oracle Primavera P6 – EVM Settings

attributes.name: forecast_finish_date
attributes.description: Current forecast completion date for this WBS element based on progress to date and remaining work, as updated in Oracle Primavera P6. Used for schedule recovery planning and LD exposure monitoring.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Early Finish (Forecast); PMI PMBOK – Schedule Forecasting; FIDIC Clause 8

attributes.name: is_lump_sum
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this WBS element is priced as a lump sum (fixed price) rather than a re-measurable unit-rate item. Affects billing, change order valuation, and BOQ reconciliation.
attributes.references: FIDIC Conditions of Contract – Lump Sum vs. Re-measurable; AACE RP 10S-90

attributes.name: is_milestone
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this WBS element represents a contractual or project milestone (e.g., NTP, substantial completion, handover). Milestone WBS elements trigger payment certificates and schedule reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Milestone Flag; FIDIC Clause 14 – Payment Milestones

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this WBS element record, either in the source system or during lakehouse processing. Supports incremental data loading and change detection.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 – Date and Time Formats; GDPR Article 5 – Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: original_budget_cost
attributes.description: The initial approved budget for this WBS element at project baseline, before any approved change orders or budget transfers. Enables variance analysis between original and current budget.
attributes.references: AACE International Recommended Practice No. 10S-90 – Cost Engineering Terminology; PMI PMBOK – Cost Baseline

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Current physical percent complete of the WBS element, representing the proportion of scope delivered to date. Used as the primary EVM progress measurement input. Range: 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Physical % Complete; PMI Practice Standard for EVM; AACE RP 11R-88

attributes.name: percent_complete_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate percent complete for EVM purposes: physical (field measurement), units_complete (quantity-based), duration (time-proportional), weighted_milestone, level_of_effort, or fixed_formula (e.g., 0/100, 50/50). Configured in Oracle Primavera P6.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – % Complete Type; PMI Practice Standard for EVM; AACE RP 11R-88

attributes.name: planned_finish_date
attributes.description: Baseline planned finish date for this WBS element as established in the approved project schedule. Used for schedule variance analysis, milestone tracking, and Liquidated Damages (LD) exposure assessment.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Planned Finish; PMI PMBOK – Schedule Baseline; FIDIC Clause 8

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Total planned quantity of work for this WBS element as defined in the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) or Material Take-Off (MTO). Used for production tracking and unit-rate cost control in HCSS HeavyJob.
attributes.references: ASCE – Quantity Surveying Standards; BOQ per FIDIC; HCSS HeavyJob – Planned Quantity

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Baseline planned start date for this WBS element as established in the approved project schedule in Oracle Primavera P6. Used for schedule variance analysis and CPM scheduling.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Planned Start; PMI PMBOK – Schedule Baseline; FIDIC Clause 8

attributes.name: planned_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Planned Value (PV) – Budgeted Cost of Work Scheduled (BCWS)
attributes.description: Budgeted cost of work scheduled to be completed by the data date for this WBS element (BCWS). Derived from the time-phased budget baseline in Primavera P6. Used to compute Schedule Variance (SV) in EVM.
attributes.references: PMI Practice Standard for Earned Value Management; Oracle Primavera P6 – Planned Value; AACE RP 11R-88

attributes.name: responsible_discipline
attributes.description: Engineering or construction discipline accountable for executing this WBS element (e.g., Civil, Structural, MEP, Electrical, Mechanical, Instrumentation). Used for resource planning and discipline-level cost reporting.
attributes.references: ASCE Standards – Engineering Disciplines; EPC Project Execution Framework

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the work scope, deliverables, and boundaries associated with this WBS element. Aligns with the project's Statement of Work (SOW) and Bill of Quantities (BOQ) scope definitions.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Guide – Scope Baseline; FIDIC Conditions of Contract – Scope of Works

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence defining the display order of this WBS element among its siblings within the same parent node. Used for consistent rendering in schedules, reports, and BOQ documents.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – WBS Sequence Number

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this WBS element record was ingested: primavera_p6 (Oracle Primavera P6), sap_ps (SAP S/4HANA Project Systems), procore, or manual entry. Supports data lineage and audit.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; SAP S/4HANA PS; Procore

attributes.name: source_system_wbs_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this WBS element in the originating operational system (e.g., Primavera P6 WBS Object ID, SAP PS WBS Element internal number). Supports data lineage and reconciliation between the lakehouse and source systems.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – WBS Object ID; SAP PS – WBS Element (PRPS-PSPNR)

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for planned and actual quantities on this WBS element (e.g., m3, m2, LF, EA, TON, LS, HR). Aligns with BOQ and MTO unit conventions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: m3|m2|LF|EA|TON|LS|HR|KG|ML|CY — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FIDIC BOQ Standards; ASCE Quantity Surveying; ISO 80000 – Quantities and Units

attributes.name: wbs_code
attributes.description: Structured alphanumeric code representing the WBS node position in the hierarchy (e.g., 1.2.3.4). Used as the externally-known identifier in Primavera P6, SAP PS, and project documentation. Conforms to project WBS coding convention.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – WBS Code Field; PMI PMBOK WBS Standard; SAP PS WBS Element Code

attributes.name: wbs_level
attributes.description: Integer depth of the WBS node within the project hierarchy (Level 1 = project root, Level 2 = major deliverable, Level 3+ = sub-deliverable or work package). Used for hierarchical filtering, rollup aggregation, and reporting drill-down.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – WBS Level; PMI PMBOK Guide

attributes.name: wbs_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the WBS element describing the scope deliverable or work package (e.g., 'Substructure Works', 'Electrical Installation – Level 3'). Used in reports, dashboards, and EVM analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – WBS Name Field; PMI Practice Standard for WBS

attributes.name: wbs_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the WBS element indicating whether work is active, not yet started, on hold, completed, or cancelled. Drives EVM eligibility and cost control reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – WBS Status; PMI PMBOK Guide – Project Scope Management

attributes.name: wbs_type
attributes.description: Classification of the WBS node by its role in the hierarchy: 'summary' (rollup node), 'work_package' (lowest deliverable-level node), 'control_account' (EVM measurement point), or 'planning_package' (future scope not yet detailed). Drives EVM rollup logic and cost control granularity.
attributes.references: PMI Practice Standard for Earned Value Management; AACE International Recommended Practice No. 11R-88

products.name: project_milestone
products.description: Key contractual and internal milestones within a construction project lifecycle, including NTP, design completion, procurement completion, construction start, mechanical completion, commissioning, and handover. Tracks planned date, forecast date, actual date, milestone type, contractual obligation flag, LD (Liquidated Damages) trigger flag, and milestone owner. Supports schedule performance and contract administration.
products.reference: Project Milestone Register — Oracle Primavera P6 / Procore

attributes.name: project_milestone_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each project milestone record in the Construction lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for the project_milestone data product.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent construction project to which this milestone belongs. Links the milestone to the core project master record.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Project Scheduling; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: owner_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.contact. Business justification: Milestone owner contact needed for client notifications and acceptance sign‑off per Milestone Management process.

attributes.name: phase_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.phase. Business justification: Milestones belong to specific project lifecycle phases (e.g., NTP milestone belongs to pre-construction phase, commissioning milestone belongs to commissioning phase). Adding phase_id FK enables phase

attributes.name: predecessor_milestone_project_milestone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding milestone in the project schedule logic chain. Supports Critical Path Method (CPM) analysis and schedule dependency tracking within the milestone network.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Activity Planning; CPM (Critical Path Method) Scheduling

attributes.name: project_baseline_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_baseline. Business justification: Project milestones are defined against an approved baseline (baseline_date on milestone corresponds to a specific project_baseline revision). Adding project_baseline_id FK anchors each milestone to th

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.site. Business justification: Contractual milestones (LD triggers, payment triggers) are site-specific on multi-site programs (e.g., airport terminal A vs B). Site-level milestone tracking is required for LD exposure reporting, pa

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element under which this milestone is classified. Enables milestone tracking at the WBS decomposition level within the project schedule.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Project Scheduling; PMI PMBOK WBS Standard

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Formal criteria that must be satisfied for the milestone to be considered achieved and accepted by the client or engineer. May reference ITP (Inspection and Test Plan) requirements, regulatory sign-offs, or contractual deliverable submissions.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; FIDIC Clause 10 Employer's Taking Over; ITP Standards

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: The date on which the milestone was formally achieved and accepted. Populated only upon milestone completion and sign-off. Used for schedule variance calculation, contract administration, and LD (Liquidated Damages) trigger assessment.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Progress Tracking; FIDIC Contract Administration; Procore Construction Management

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Approved contract baseline date for the milestone, which may differ from the original planned date if a formal baseline revision or approved EOT (Extension of Time) has been incorporated. Used as the contractual reference for LD (Liquidated Damages) exposure calculation.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management; FIDIC Clause 8; PMO Baseline Control

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of work completed toward achieving this milestone, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Updated during progress reporting cycles. Used for EVM (Earned Value Management) percent-complete calculations and schedule performance tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Progress Tracking; EVM ANSI/EIA-748; Procore Construction Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this milestone record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data governance and lineage tracking in the Databricks lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: The project delivery model under which this milestone is defined and tracked. Determines the contractual framework and milestone obligation structure. EPC = Engineering Procurement Construction; DB = Design-Build; DBB = Design-Bid-Build; PPP = Public-Private Partnership; BOT = Build-Operate-Transfer; GMP = Guaranteed Maximum Price.
attributes.references: FIDIC Conditions of Contract; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: eot_days_approved
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days of approved Extension of Time (EOT) granted for this milestone under the contract. Reflects cumulative approved EOT claims that have adjusted the baseline date. Zero if no EOT has been granted.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 8.4 Extension of Time for Completion; Contract Administration

attributes.name: eot_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the approved EOT (Extension of Time) claim or contract amendment that adjusted the baseline date for this milestone. Used for contract administration audit trail and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 8.4 Extension of Time; Aconex Document Management; Contract Administration

attributes.name: forecast_date
attributes.description: Current best estimate of the date on which the milestone will be achieved, updated during schedule reviews and progress reporting cycles. Reflects schedule recovery plans, approved EOT (Extension of Time) claims, and current site conditions.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Progress Tracking; EVM (Earned Value Management) Schedule Forecasting

attributes.name: hse_clearance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety Environment (HSE) Clearance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether HSE (Health, Safety and Environment) regulatory clearance or permit is a prerequisite for achieving this milestone (e.g., commissioning milestones requiring OSHA or EPA sign-off). True = HSE clearance must be obtained before milestone can be marked complete.
attributes.references: OSHA Occupational Safety and Health Administration; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; EPA Environmental Protection Agency

attributes.name: is_contractual
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone is a contractually obligated key date as defined in the project contract (FIDIC, GMP, or bespoke agreement). True = contractual obligation with potential LD (Liquidated Damages) or payment consequences; False = internal PMO or programme milestone.
attributes.references: FIDIC Conditions of Contract; Contract Administration Standards

attributes.name: is_critical_path
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone lies on the Critical Path Method (CPM) critical path of the project schedule. True = any delay to this milestone directly delays the project completion date; False = milestone has float and is not on the critical path.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 CPM Scheduling; PMI PMBOK Schedule Management

attributes.name: is_ld_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates whether missing this milestone triggers Liquidated Damages (LD) as specified in the contract. True = LD clause applies upon delay; False = no LD exposure for this milestone. Critical for contract risk management and financial exposure reporting.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 8.7 Delay Damages; Contract Administration; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: is_payment_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates whether achievement of this milestone triggers a contractual payment event or progress payment certificate under the contract payment schedule. True = milestone completion initiates a payment claim or invoice; False = no direct payment linkage.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 14 Contract Price and Payment; SAP S/4HANA Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: ld_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the Liquidated Damages (LD) daily rate (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AED). Ensures correct financial exposure reporting in multi-currency international EPC projects.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: ld_rate_per_day
attributes.description: The contractually agreed daily monetary rate of Liquidated Damages (LD) applicable if this milestone is not achieved by the baseline date. Expressed in the project contract currency. Populated only when is_ld_trigger = True. Sensitive commercial data.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 8.7 Delay Damages; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: leed_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone is associated with LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification requirements or green building compliance deliverables. True = milestone contributes to LEED certification pathway.
attributes.references: LEED U.S. Green Building Council; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: milestone_category
attributes.description: Functional category grouping the milestone within the EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) project lifecycle phase. Supports schedule performance analysis by phase and PMO reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: design|procurement|construction|commissioning|handover|safety|financial|administrative — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPC Project Lifecycle Framework; Oracle Primavera P6 Project Scheduling

attributes.name: milestone_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the milestone within the project schedule, as assigned in Oracle Primavera P6 (e.g., MS-NTP001, MS-MC001). Used for cross-system referencing and contract administration.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Project Scheduling; FIDIC Contract Administration

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the milestone describing the key project event or deliverable (e.g., 'Notice to Proceed (NTP)', 'Mechanical Completion', 'Substantial Completion', 'Final Handover'). Used in schedule reports and contract documents.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Project Scheduling; FIDIC Conditions of Contract

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the milestone tracking its progress toward completion. 'not_started' = work not yet begun; 'in_progress' = activities underway; 'completed' = milestone achieved; 'overdue' = past planned date without completion; 'waived' = formally waived by contract amendment; 'deferred' = postponed with approved EOT (Extension of Time).
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Progress Tracking; FIDIC Clause 8 Extension of Time

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the milestone by its origin and obligation level. 'contractual' = bound by contract terms (FIDIC/GMP); 'internal' = PMO governance milestone; 'regulatory' = required by OSHA/EPA/IBC; 'client' = client-driven key date; 'financial' = triggers payment or LD exposure.
attributes.references: FIDIC Conditions of Contract; PMO Governance Framework; OSHA Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: notification_advance_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days in advance of the milestone date that formal notification must be issued to the client or engineer, as required by the contract. Applicable when notification_required = True. Supports contract compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: FIDIC Conditions of Contract; Contract Administration Standards

attributes.name: notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal written notification to the client or engineer is contractually required prior to or upon achievement of this milestone. True = notification obligation exists per contract; False = no formal notification required.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 8 Commencement, Delays and Suspension; Contract Administration

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Contractual payment amount due upon achievement of this milestone, expressed in the project contract currency. Applicable only when is_payment_trigger = True. Used for cash flow forecasting and contract financial management.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 14 Contract Price and Payment; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: planned_date
attributes.description: Original baseline date on which the milestone was scheduled to be achieved, as established at project kick-off or NTP (Notice to Proceed). Serves as the schedule baseline reference for variance analysis and SPI (Schedule Performance Index) calculation.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management; FIDIC Conditions of Contract

attributes.name: procore_milestone_reference
attributes.description: The corresponding milestone or schedule item identifier in Procore Construction Management platform. Supports cross-system reconciliation between the scheduling system of record (Primavera P6) and the construction management platform (Procore).
attributes.references: Procore Construction Management; Data Integration Standards

attributes.name: project_milestone_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the milestone, including the scope of work, acceptance criteria, and deliverables required to formally achieve the milestone. Sourced from the contract schedule or project execution plan.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Project Scheduling; FIDIC Conditions of Contract

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for project team notes, status commentary, risk flags, or contextual information related to the milestone. Used during progress review meetings and PMO reporting to capture qualitative schedule narrative.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Framework; Oracle Primavera P6 Project Scheduling

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: The contracting party primarily responsible for achieving this milestone. Distinguishes between the General Contractor (GC), client, subcontractor, engineer/designer, Joint Venture (JV) partner, or regulatory authority. Critical for contract administration and risk allocation.
attributes.references: FIDIC Conditions of Contract; Contract Administration Standards

attributes.name: schedule_variance_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days by which the milestone is ahead of (negative) or behind (positive) the baseline date. Calculated as forecast_date minus baseline_date for open milestones, or actual_date minus baseline_date for completed milestones. Key input for SPI (Schedule Performance Index) reporting.
attributes.references: EVM (Earned Value Management) ANSI/EIA-748; Oracle Primavera P6 Schedule Analysis

attributes.name: sign_off_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference number of the formal sign-off document, completion certificate, or taking-over certificate issued upon milestone achievement (e.g., Aconex document number, Procore submittal reference). Provides audit trail for contract administration and handover documentation.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 10 Taking Over Certificate; Aconex Document Management; Procore Construction Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this milestone record was ingested into the Databricks lakehouse Silver layer. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and master data management across the construction technology stack.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: total_float_days
attributes.description: Total schedule float in calendar days available for this milestone before it impacts the project completion date, as calculated by the CPM (Critical Path Method) schedule engine in Oracle Primavera P6. Zero or negative float indicates critical or super-critical status.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 CPM Scheduling; ANSI/EIA-748 EVM Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this milestone record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; Data Governance Standards

products.name: project_baseline
products.description: Approved project baseline and budget revision record maintaining the complete audit trail of authorized scope, schedule, and cost parameters throughout the project lifecycle. Each record captures a point-in-time snapshot: baseline type (original, revised, re-baseline, CO incorporation, re-forecast, management reserve release), revision number, revision date, approval date, approving authority, total baseline cost, baseline duration, baseline start and finish dates, budget amount before and after revision, cost account or WBS-level budget breakdown, and justification narrative. Supports EVM variance analysis (current performance vs approved baseline), change impact tracking, budget evolution audit trail at both project and cost-account level, and PMO governance and financial audit requirements.
products.reference: Project Baseline — Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management

attributes.name: project_baseline_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each approved project baseline record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the baseline data product.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Standards; Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management

attributes.name: client_approver_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.contact. Business justification: Client baseline approval is a contractually binding event in construction. is_client_approved exists but no FK identifies which client contact approved it. Contract administration and audit processes

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent construction project for which this baseline record was established. Links the baseline to the project master record.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Project Systems; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems (PS)

attributes.name: schedule_baseline_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.schedule_baseline. Business justification: Integrated Baseline Reviews (IBR) in construction require pairing a cost/scope project baseline with its corresponding schedule baseline. EVM reporting, contract compliance audits, and change control

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element at which this baseline budget and schedule snapshot is captured. Enables cost-account-level baseline tracking per EVM methodology.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 WBS; PMI PMBOK WBS Standard; EVM (Earned Value Management) Guidelines

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the baseline was formally approved by the designated approving authority. Marks the effective start of the approved baseline for EVM measurement and PMO reporting.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Standards; FIDIC Contract Administration; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: Governance tier at which this baseline was approved, reflecting the authorization hierarchy. Higher-value or re-baseline revisions typically require elevated approval levels per PMO governance policy.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Standards; FIDIC Contract Administration

attributes.name: baseline_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the baseline record, used in PMO reporting, EVM analysis, and audit documentation. Format: BL-{ProjectCode}-{SequenceNumber}.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management; PMO Governance Standards

attributes.name: baseline_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the baseline record within the PMO approval workflow. Draft baselines are under preparation; pending_approval awaits sign-off; approved is the active authorized baseline; superseded indicates a newer revision has replaced it; cancelled denotes a withdrawn baseline.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Standards; Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management

attributes.name: baseline_type
attributes.description: Classification of the baseline record indicating the nature of the snapshot: original (initial approved baseline), revised (minor scope/cost adjustment), re_baseline (full project re-baselining), co_incorporation (Change Order incorporated), re_forecast (updated forecast adopted as new baseline), management_reserve_release (management reserve funds released into budget).
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Baseline Management; EVM (Earned Value Management) Guidelines; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: budget_after_revision
attributes.description: Total approved budget amount immediately following this baseline revision. Together with budget_before_revision, provides the complete budget delta audit trail for PMO governance and financial audit requirements.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Standards; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: budget_at_completion
attributes.description: Total approved budget for the project or WBS element as captured in this baseline snapshot, representing the Budget at Completion (BAC) in the EVM framework. This is the total planned cost against which CPI (Cost Performance Index) and cost variance are measured.
attributes.references: EVM (Earned Value Management) Guidelines; PMI PMBOK; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: budget_before_revision
attributes.description: Total approved budget amount immediately prior to this baseline revision. Enables audit trail tracking of budget evolution and quantification of the budget delta introduced by each revision.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Standards; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: co_value_incorporated
attributes.description: Total monetary value of Change Orders (COs) incorporated into this baseline revision. Quantifies the cumulative scope change impact on the approved budget for audit trail and contract administration purposes.
attributes.references: Procore Change Orders; FIDIC Contract Administration; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: contingency_amount
attributes.description: Approved contingency reserve budget included within this baseline, allocated to cover identified project risks and uncertainties. Distinct from management reserve which is held outside the project baseline.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Risk Management; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; PMO Governance Standards

attributes.name: contract_value
attributes.description: Total authorized contract value associated with this baseline, as agreed with the client or owner. Used to reconcile the project budget against the contracted revenue and to track budget-to-contract alignment.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Administration; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: cost_account_code
attributes.description: Cost account or cost code identifier at which this baseline budget is allocated, enabling WBS-level budget breakdown and cost-account-level EVM variance analysis. Aligns with the project cost coding structure in SAP S/4HANA and Viewpoint Vista.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems; Viewpoint Vista Job Costing; EVM (Earned Value Management) Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this baseline record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR/Privacy Regulations; PMO Governance Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts in this baseline record are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency project financial reporting for international EPC projects.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: Construction project delivery model under which this baseline was established. Determines the contractual framework and approval requirements: EPC (Engineering Procurement Construction), DB (Design-Build), DBB (Design-Bid-Build), PPP (Public-Private Partnership), BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer), GMP (Guaranteed Maximum Price).
attributes.references: FIDIC (International Federation of Consulting Engineers); PMO Governance Standards

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Approved total duration of the project or WBS element in calendar days as captured in this baseline snapshot. Derived from baseline start and finish dates; stored explicitly for EVM schedule variance analysis and reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management; EVM (Earned Value Management) Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this baseline was superseded by a subsequent revision or closed. Null if this is the currently active approved baseline. Supports audit trail and historical EVM analysis.
attributes.references: EVM (Earned Value Management) Guidelines; PMO Governance Standards

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this approved baseline becomes the active reference for EVM variance analysis and project performance measurement. Typically aligns with approval_date or the NTP (Notice to Proceed) date for original baselines.
attributes.references: EVM (Earned Value Management) Guidelines; PMI PMBOK; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: eot_days_granted
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of Extension of Time (EOT) granted and incorporated into this baseline revision. Tracks the cumulative schedule relief authorized through contract administration, impacting the baseline finish date.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Administration; PMO Governance Standards; Procore Change Orders

attributes.name: finish_date
attributes.description: Approved planned finish date for the project or WBS element as captured in this baseline snapshot. Used as the schedule reference for SPI (Schedule Performance Index) calculation and milestone tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management; CPM (Critical Path Method); EVM Guidelines

attributes.name: is_client_approved
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the client or owner has formally approved this baseline revision. Relevant for contract-driven baselines under FIDIC, GMP (Guaranteed Maximum Price), or EPC delivery models where client sign-off is contractually required.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Administration; PMO Governance Standards; Procore Change Orders

attributes.name: is_current_baseline
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this record represents the currently active approved baseline for the project or WBS element. Only one baseline per project/WBS should have this flag set to True at any point in time.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management; EVM (Earned Value Management) Guidelines

attributes.name: management_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Management reserve budget held outside the project baseline for unknown unknowns, as authorized by senior management. Tracked separately from contingency reserve per EVM methodology. Populated when baseline_type is management_reserve_release.
attributes.references: EVM (Earned Value Management) Guidelines; PMI PMBOK; PMO Governance Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional PMO or project controls notes, assumptions, constraints, or caveats associated with this baseline record. Supplements the formal revision justification narrative.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Standards; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: planned_value
attributes.description: Planned Value (PV) — the authorized budget assigned to scheduled work in this baseline snapshot, also known as Budgeted Cost of Work Scheduled (BCWS) in EVM methodology. Serves as the EVM performance measurement baseline reference.
attributes.references: EVM (Earned Value Management) Guidelines; PMI PMBOK; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: primavera_baseline_reference
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this baseline record as assigned by Oracle Primavera P6. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational scheduling system.

attributes.name: revision_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the baseline revision was formally prepared and submitted for approval. Represents the point-in-time snapshot date for scope, schedule, and cost parameters.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management; PMO Governance Standards

attributes.name: revision_justification
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of the business reason for this baseline revision, including the drivers of scope, schedule, or cost changes. Required for PMO governance approval and financial audit documentation.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Standards; FIDIC Contract Administration; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer indicating the revision iteration of the baseline for a given project or WBS element. Revision 0 denotes the original approved baseline; subsequent revisions increment by 1.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management; PMO Change Control Process

attributes.name: sap_project_version
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems version identifier corresponding to this baseline snapshot. Used for reconciliation between the ERP project budget version and the Primavera schedule baseline.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems (PS); PMO Governance Standards

attributes.name: schedule_data_date
attributes.description: The data date (status date) of the Oracle Primavera P6 schedule from which this baseline snapshot was extracted. Defines the point-in-time reference for all schedule parameters captured in this record.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management; CPM (Critical Path Method)

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the approved project scope captured in this baseline snapshot. Documents the authorized scope boundaries, key deliverables, and inclusions/exclusions at the time of baseline approval.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Scope Management; Oracle Primavera P6; PMO Governance Standards

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Approved planned start date for the project or WBS element as captured in this baseline snapshot. Used as the schedule reference for SPI (Schedule Performance Index) calculation and CPM (Critical Path Method) analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management; CPM (Critical Path Method); EVM Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this baseline record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR/Privacy Regulations; PMO Governance Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: variance_at_completion
attributes.description: Variance at Completion (VAC) — the difference between the Budget at Completion (BAC) and the Estimate at Completion (EAC) at the time this baseline was established. Provides a forward-looking cost performance indicator for PMO reporting.
attributes.references: EVM (Earned Value Management) Guidelines; PMI PMBOK

products.name: progress_measurement
products.description: Periodic physical progress measurement record at WBS element or activity level, capturing percent complete, earned quantity, installed quantity, measurement method (weighted steps, milestone, units complete), measurement date, reporting period, and verifying engineer. Feeds EVM calculations and progress billing. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob production tracking and Procore field management.
products.reference: Progress Measurement — Procore / HCSS HeavyJob Production Tracking

attributes.name: progress_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each periodic physical progress measurement record. Primary key for the progress_measurement data product in the project domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: PMO Governance Standard; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific schedule activity within the WBS element being measured. Corresponds to the Primavera P6 activity object used in CPM (Critical Path Method) scheduling.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; HCSS HeavyJob Production Tracking

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent construction project against which this progress measurement is recorded. Links to the project master entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: cost_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cost_account. Business justification: Progress measurements capture physical progress at WBS/activity level, while cost accounts represent the control account intersection of WBS and cost code. Linking progress_measurement to cost_account

attributes.name: progress_update_id

attributes.name: project_baseline_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.project_budget. Business justification: Progress measurements are validated against the project budget for EVM reporting and billing eligibility determination. The progress_measurement.is_billing_eligible and budget_at_completion fields req
