attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element representing the scope of works being handed over. Enables traceability from certificate to project scope decomposition.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; PMI PMBOK WBS Standard

attributes.name: aconex_document_reference
attributes.description: The document identifier assigned to the handover certificate in the Aconex document management system. Enables traceability to the official correspondence and transmittal register for audit and contractual purposes.

attributes.name: as_built_drawing_reference
attributes.description: Document transmittal or register reference for the as-built drawings submitted as part of the handover package. Confirms that record drawings have been delivered to the client.

attributes.name: bim_model_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number of the as-built Building Information Modeling (BIM) model associated with the handed-over works. Links the certificate to the digital asset record in Autodesk BIM 360 for O&M (Operations and Maintenance) purposes.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique reference number for the handover certificate as issued and registered in the document management system (e.g., Aconex). Used in correspondence, transmittals, and contractual communications.
attributes.references: Aconex Document Management; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: certificate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the handover certificate. Draft: under preparation; Issued: formally submitted to client; Accepted: client has signed acceptance; Rejected: client has declined acceptance; Superseded: replaced by a revised certificate.
attributes.references: Procore Submittals Workflow; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: client_acceptance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client formally accepted and signed the handover certificate, confirming transfer of care, custody, and control of the works. Triggers the start of the Defects Liability Period (DLP).
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 10.1; ASCE Project Delivery Standards

attributes.name: client_signatory_title
attributes.description: Job title or designation of the client representative who signed the handover certificate (e.g., Client Project Manager, Engineer's Representative, Owner's Representative). Validates the authority level of the acceptance.

attributes.name: commissioning_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether commissioning activities have been fully completed for the works included in the handover scope. Commissioning completion is a mandatory prerequisite for final handover in EPC and infrastructure projects.

attributes.name: contractor_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized contractor representative who signed the handover certificate on behalf of the contractor organization. Required for contractual validity of the certificate.

attributes.name: contractor_signatory_title
attributes.description: Job title or designation of the contractor representative who signed the handover certificate (e.g., Project Director, Site Manager, Construction Manager). Validates the authority level of the signatory.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the handover certificate record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting data lineage, compliance, and record management requirements.

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: The contractual delivery model under which the project is executed and the handover is being performed. Determines the applicable handover procedures and obligations. EPC: Engineering Procurement Construction; DB: Design-Build; DBB: Design-Bid-Build; PPP: Public-Private Partnership; BOT: Build-Operate-Transfer; GMP: Guaranteed Maximum Price.
attributes.references: FIDIC Conditions of Contract; PMO Governance Framework

attributes.name: dlp_duration_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Defects Liability Period (DLP) Duration in Days
attributes.description: The contractually agreed duration of the Defects Liability Period (DLP) expressed in calendar days. Typically 365 days (12 months) for standard construction contracts but may vary by contract type and jurisdiction.

attributes.name: dlp_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Defects Liability Period (DLP) expires, after which the contractor's obligation to remedy defects under the contract ceases. Calculated from DLP start date plus the contractually agreed DLP duration.

attributes.name: dlp_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Defects Liability Period (DLP) commences, typically aligned with the client acceptance date. Marks the beginning of the contractor's obligation to remedy defects at no additional cost.

attributes.name: engineer_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Engineer (or Engineer's Representative) under FIDIC contracts who countersigns the handover certificate. Applicable under FIDIC Red/Yellow/Silver Book delivery models where an independent Engineer administers the contract.

attributes.name: eot_days_applied
attributes.description: Total number of Extension of Time (EOT) days granted and applied to the contractual completion date for the scope covered by this handover certificate. Affects LD liability calculation and schedule performance reporting.

attributes.name: fat_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) has been completed for all equipment and systems included in the handover scope. FAT is a prerequisite for handover in EPC and MEP-intensive projects.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 8.6; IEC Factory Acceptance Standards

attributes.name: handover_type
attributes.description: Classification of the handover certificate indicating the nature and extent of the transfer of works. Partial: a defined portion of works; Sectional: a contractually defined section; Substantial Completion: works are practically complete with minor outstanding items; Final: all works including punch list resolved; Provisional: conditional acceptance pending outstanding items.
attributes.references: FIDIC Conditions of Contract Clause 10; IBC Completion Standards

attributes.name: hse_clearance_obtained
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Clearance Obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) clearances and regulatory approvals have been obtained prior to handover. Includes OSHA compliance, environmental permits, and occupancy certificates.
attributes.references: OSHA Standards; ISO 45001; ISO 14001; EPA Regulations

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the handover certificate was formally issued by the contractor to the client. This is the principal business event date (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category) representing the real-world transfer initiation event.

attributes.name: itp_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether all Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) hold points and witness points for the works scope have been completed and signed off prior to handover. ITP completion is a mandatory QA/QC prerequisite for handover.

attributes.name: ld_liability_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contractor's exposure to Liquidated Damages (LD) for delay ceases, typically aligned with the handover acceptance date. Critical for financial exposure tracking and contract administration.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 8.7; SAP S/4HANA Contract Management

attributes.name: leed_certification_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Level
attributes.description: LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification level achieved for the works being handed over, if applicable. Relevant for commercial and public sector projects with sustainability requirements.
attributes.references: LEED U.S. Green Building Council; ISO 14001

attributes.name: ncr_count
attributes.description: Total number of open Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) against the works scope at the time of handover certificate issuance. Open NCRs may be a condition precedent to client acceptance under QA/QC requirements.

attributes.name: om_manual_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number for the Operations and Maintenance (O&M) manual submitted as part of the handover package. Confirms that O&M documentation has been provided to the client as a condition of handover.

attributes.name: procore_submittal_reference
attributes.description: The submittal identifier assigned to the handover certificate package in Procore Construction Management. Enables cross-system traceability between the data lakehouse and the operational construction management platform.

attributes.name: punch_list_close_date
attributes.description: The date by which all outstanding punch list items are contractually required to be resolved and closed. Agreed between contractor and client at the time of handover.

attributes.name: punch_list_critical_count
attributes.description: Number of punch list items classified as critical or Category A at the time of handover, representing items that must be resolved before or immediately after handover. Distinct from total punch list count.
attributes.references: Procore Punch List; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: punch_list_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of outstanding punch list items (minor defects, incomplete works, or non-conformances) recorded at the time of handover certificate issuance. A key indicator of completion quality at handover.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason(s) for client rejection of the handover certificate, if applicable. Populated when certificate_status is 'rejected'. Supports root cause analysis and resubmission planning.
attributes.references: Procore RFI and Submittal Workflow; ISO 9001 Non-Conformance

attributes.name: retention_release_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issuance of this handover certificate triggers eligibility for release of contractual retention monies held by the client. Typically, substantial completion or final handover certificates trigger partial or full retention release.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 14.9; SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision number of the handover certificate, incremented each time the certificate is revised and reissued following client rejection or scope amendment. Revision 0 represents the original issue.
attributes.references: Aconex Document Management; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: sat_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) has been completed for all systems and equipment included in the handover scope. SAT confirms that systems function correctly in their installed environment prior to handover.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 8.6; IEC Site Acceptance Standards

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the works, systems, or areas being handed over under this certificate. Defines the physical and functional boundary of the handover including building sections, infrastructure systems, or MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) systems.

attributes.name: spare_parts_delivered
attributes.description: Indicates whether all contractually required spare parts and consumables have been delivered to the client as part of the handover package. Spare parts delivery is a standard handover condition in EPC and infrastructure contracts.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 10; SAP S/4HANA Materials Management

attributes.name: training_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractor has completed all contractually required training for the client's operations and maintenance personnel on the handed-over systems and equipment.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the handover certificate record was last modified in the system. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring in the Databricks Silver Layer.

products.name: project_site
products.description: Master reference table for site. Referenced by site_id.

attributes.description: Primary key for site

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the project to which the site belongs.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Construction sites are assigned to cost centers for site-level cost tracking, overhead allocation, and financial reporting. The site.cost_center_code is a denormalized reference. A proper FK enables s

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.schedule_calendar. Schedulers assign a calendar to a site to govern activity duration c

attributes.name: actual_spend

attributes.name: address_line1

attributes.name: address_line2

attributes.name: area_sq_m

attributes.name: budget_amount

attributes.name: city

attributes.name: country
attributes.description: ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑3 country code where the site resides.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: elevation_m

attributes.name: environmental_zone
attributes.description: Environmental compliance zone applicable to the site.

attributes.name: ground_condition
attributes.description: Observed condition of the ground (e.g., rocky, soft, contaminated).

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the insurance covering the site.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent health, safety, or regulatory inspection.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude of the site in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude of the site in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: manager_email

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the person responsible for site operations.

attributes.name: manager_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the site manager.

attributes.name: number_of_floors
attributes.description: Count of building floors present on the site.

attributes.name: permits
attributes.description: Comma‑separated list of permits and licenses held for the site.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Target date for finishing construction work.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal/ZIP code for the site address.

attributes.name: power_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Maximum electrical power capacity available on site in megawatts.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk rating assigned to the site.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Security classification of the site based on risk and access controls.

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: External code used to reference the site in contracts and plans.

attributes.name: site_description
attributes.description: Free‑form textual description of the site.

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the construction site.

attributes.name: site_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the site.

attributes.name: site_type
attributes.description: Category of the site based on its primary function.

attributes.name: soil_type
attributes.description: Classification of soil present at the site.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when construction activities are scheduled to begin.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: State or province of the site location.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the site record.

attributes.name: utility_connection_status
attributes.description: Current status of utility (electric, water, gas) connections.

attributes.name: water_supply_type
attributes.description: Primary source of water for the site.

domains.name: client
domains.description: Master client/owner data managing relationships with project owners, developers, and sponsors who commission construction work. Owns client profiles, account hierarchies, JV structures, stakeholder contacts, communication preferences, and relationship history. Supports CRM (Customer Relationship Management), opportunity pipeline management, and client segmentation across public-sector, private-sector, and PPP/BOT arrangements.

products.name: account
products.description: Master record for each client/owner organization that commissions construction work. SSOT for client identity across public-sector agencies, private developers, government bodies, and corporate sponsors. Captures legal entity name, registration number, tax ID, industry sector, client tier, credit rating, preferred contract type (EPC, GMP, DBB, PPP, BOT), account status, CRM account owner, and segment assignments. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Account object. All other client domain products reference this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the client/owner account record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the account master entity.

attributes.name: parent_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent account record for clients that are subsidiaries or divisions within a larger corporate hierarchy. Enables account hierarchy traversal for consolidated reporting and group-level relationship management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: primary_ultimate_parent_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the top-level account in the corporate hierarchy (ultimate holding entity). Used for group-level exposure analysis, consolidated pipeline reporting, and enterprise relationship management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the client account. Controls whether the account is eligible for new project bids, contract awards, and CRM pipeline activities.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the client account by ownership and sector type. Drives contract template selection, compliance requirements, and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: public_sector|private_sector|government_body|corporate_sponsor|jv_entity|ppp_authority — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; FIDIC Contract Classification

attributes.name: annual_revenue
attributes.description: Reported or estimated annual revenue of the client organisation in the account's billing currency. Used for client segmentation, credit assessment, and strategic account prioritisation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: billing_address
attributes.description: Address to which invoices and financial correspondence are directed for this client account. May differ from the registered address. Used in SAP S/4HANA accounts receivable and Viewpoint Vista job costing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AR Module; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: bim_requirement_level
attributes.description: Level of Building Information Modeling (BIM) mandated by the client for construction projects. Drives design collaboration tooling requirements (e.g., Autodesk BIM 360), data exchange standards, and project delivery methodology.
attributes.references: Autodesk BIM 360; ISO 19650 BIM Standard; BIM (Building Information Modeling) Level Definitions

attributes.name: client_tier
attributes.description: Strategic segmentation tier assigned to the client based on revenue potential, relationship depth, and strategic importance. Tier 1 represents the highest-value clients. Drives account management resource allocation and executive engagement levels.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; PMO Client Segmentation Framework

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country of incorporation or primary operations for the client organisation. Used for jurisdictional compliance, tax treatment, and geographic segmentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the account record was first created in the source Salesforce CRM system. Represents the audit trail creation event for the master client record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Confidentiality)

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding receivable balance approved for this client account. Used by the finance team to manage exposure and payment risk on construction contracts. Expressed in the account's billing currency.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards; SAP S/4HANA AR Module

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: External credit rating assigned to the client organisation by a recognised credit rating agency (e.g., S&P, Moody's, Fitch) or internal credit assessment score. Used for financial risk evaluation, payment terms negotiation, and bonding/surety decisions.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards; PCI DSS

attributes.name: crm_account_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for the account as recorded in Salesforce CRM. Used for cross-system reconciliation and lineage tracing back to the operational system of record.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary billing currency for this client account (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, AED). Used for contract valuation, invoicing, and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether outbound marketing and unsolicited commercial communications to this client account are restricted. Set to True when the client has opted out of communications or is subject to legal/regulatory restrictions. Supports GDPR compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Consent); GDPR Article 21 (Right to Object); Privacy Regulations

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System identifier for the client organisation. Used for credit assessment, supplier/client qualification, and global entity resolution.

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: Approximate number of employees in the client organisation. Used as a proxy for organisational scale, procurement capacity, and client segmentation in CRM analytics.

attributes.name: eot_policy
attributes.description: Client's standard policy for granting Extension of Time (EOT) on construction contracts. Indicates whether the client follows standard FIDIC provisions, applies strict timelines, or allows flexible negotiation. Used in bid risk evaluation.
attributes.references: FIDIC General Conditions of Contract; EOT (Extension of Time) Provisions

attributes.name: hse_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client mandates specific Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) compliance standards (e.g., ISO 45001, OSHA requirements, client-specific HSE plans) as a condition of contract. Drives HSE planning and prequalification requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration); ISO 45001; ISO 14001

attributes.name: industry_sector
attributes.description: Primary industry sector of the client organisation (e.g., Infrastructure, Energy, Real Estate, Transportation, Healthcare, Government). Used for market segmentation and opportunity pipeline analytics in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; NAICS Industry Classification

attributes.name: is_jv_entity
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client account represents a Joint Venture (JV) entity formed specifically for a construction project or programme. JV entities require special contract administration, profit-sharing arrangements, and consolidated reporting.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Provisions; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the account record in the source Salesforce CRM system. Used for change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Confidentiality)

attributes.name: last_project_award_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent contract or project award from this client. Used to identify dormant accounts, measure relationship recency, and prioritise re-engagement activities in the CRM pipeline.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Object; Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: ld_clause_standard
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client typically enforces Liquidated Damages (LD) clauses in construction contracts, and whether the LD terms are standard or negotiable. Informs bid risk assessment and contract strategy.
attributes.references: FIDIC General Conditions of Contract; LD (Liquidated Damages) Clause

attributes.name: leed_certification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client requires LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification for construction projects. Drives design, procurement, and construction methodology decisions to meet green building standards.
attributes.references: LEED (U.S. Green Building Council); ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the client/owner organisation as it appears on contracts, invoices, and regulatory filings. This is the authoritative identity label for the account.
attributes.references: FIDIC General Conditions of Contract; IFRS/GAAP Entity Identification Standards

attributes.name: ntp_authority_level
attributes.description: Describes the client's internal authority level or approval threshold required to issue a Notice to Proceed (NTP) on construction contracts. Used in contract administration to understand client governance and approval workflows.
attributes.references: FIDIC General Conditions of Contract; NTP (Notice to Proceed) Standard

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms agreed with the client for construction contracts (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, milestone-based, progress payment). Drives accounts receivable management and cash flow forecasting in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: FIDIC General Conditions of Contract; SAP S/4HANA AR Module; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: preferred_contract_type
attributes.description: Client's preferred contract delivery model for construction engagements. Options include Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC), Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP), Design-Bid-Build (DBB), Design-Build (DB), Public-Private Partnership (PPP), and Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT). Informs bid strategy and contract template selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EPC|GMP|DBB|DB|PPP|BOT|FIDIC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FIDIC General Conditions of Contract; ASCE Contract Standards

attributes.name: prequalification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the client's prequalification approval expires and requires renewal. Used to trigger re-assessment workflows and ensure compliance before new contract awards.
attributes.references: FIDIC Prequalification of Tenderers; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: prequalification_status
attributes.description: Current prequalification status of the client as a commissioning entity. Indicates whether the client has been assessed and approved for contract award eligibility, is pending review, or has an expired/rejected qualification.
attributes.references: FIDIC Prequalification of Tenderers; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact at the client organisation. Used for RFI responses, RFP submissions, contract correspondence, and CRM communication tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary point of contact at the client organisation for commercial and contractual matters. Typically the client's project director, procurement manager, or authorised representative.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; FIDIC Engineer/Employer Representative

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Direct telephone number for the primary contact at the client organisation. Used for urgent project communications, bid clarifications, and relationship management activities.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: registered_address
attributes.description: Full registered office address of the client organisation as recorded with the relevant business registry. Used for legal correspondence, contract execution, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FIDIC General Conditions of Contract

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official company or entity registration number issued by the relevant national or state business registry authority. Used for legal entity verification and compliance due diligence.
attributes.references: IBC (International Building Code Council); FIDIC; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the business relationship with this client was formally established (e.g., first contract award, first NTP issued, or CRM account creation date). Used for relationship tenure analysis and loyalty segmentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; FIDIC NTP (Notice to Proceed)

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number (e.g., EIN, VAT number, GST number) for the client entity. Required for invoicing, contract administration, and financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards; IRS EIN; VAT Directive

attributes.name: trading_name
attributes.description: Operating or brand name used by the client organisation in day-to-day business, which may differ from the registered legal name. Used in CRM displays and correspondence.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website address of the client organisation. Used for due diligence, background research, and CRM account enrichment.

products.name: contact
products.description: Individual stakeholder contact associated with a client account, including project owners, technical representatives, procurement officers, legal counsel, and executive sponsors. Captures full name, job title, department, email, phone, preferred communication channel, decision-making authority level, and relationship health indicator. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Contact object.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the individual stakeholder contact record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the contact data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent client account (project owner, developer, or sponsor) to which this contact belongs. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Account object.

attributes.name: mailing_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.address. Business justification: The contact table carries five denormalized mailing address fields (mailing_street, mailing_city, mailing_state, mailing_postal_code, mailing_country) that duplicate the address master table. The addr

attributes.name: reports_to_contact_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the contact's direct manager or superior within the client organisation. Enables hierarchical stakeholder mapping and organisational chart modelling for large client accounts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Hierarchy; PMO Stakeholder Mapping

attributes.name: account_manager
attributes.description: Full name of the internal account manager or business development representative responsible for managing the relationship with this contact. Used for ownership assignment and pipeline accountability in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Owner; PMO Stakeholder Management

attributes.name: birthdate
attributes.description: Date of birth of the contact. Stored for relationship personalisation purposes (e.g., milestone acknowledgements) and identity verification in regulated markets. Handled under strict GDPR data minimisation principles.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimisation); Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: client_segment
attributes.description: Segment classification of the client organisation associated with this contact. Supports client segmentation analytics across public-sector, private-sector, Public-Private Partnership (PPP), Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), and Joint Venture (JV) arrangements.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Segmentation; FIDIC PPP/BOT Frameworks

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record within the CRM system. 'active' indicates an engaged stakeholder; 'inactive' indicates no recent engagement; 'archived' indicates the contact has left the organisation; 'do_not_contact' indicates a communication opt-out or legal restriction.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21 (Right to Object); Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact's functional role in the client relationship (e.g., owner representative, technical representative, procurement officer, legal counsel, executive sponsor, financial approver). Drives stakeholder engagement strategy and communication routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: owner|technical|procurement|legal|executive|financial|hse|commercial — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; FIDIC Contract Administration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the contact record was first created in the source Salesforce CRM system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and CRM record age analytics in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Logging; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: crm_contact_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this contact as recorded in Salesforce CRM Contact object. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing back to the operational system of record.

attributes.name: data_consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contact's data processing consent was last recorded or updated. Required for GDPR compliance audit trails to demonstrate lawful basis for processing personal data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42; Salesforce CRM Consent Management

attributes.name: data_consent_status
attributes.description: Current status of the contact's consent for personal data processing under applicable privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA). Tracks whether consent has been granted, withdrawn, is pending confirmation, or is not required (e.g., legitimate interest basis).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.100; Salesforce CRM Consent Management

attributes.name: decision_authority_level
attributes.description: Indicates the contact's level of decision-making authority within the client organisation for construction project approvals, contract awards, and change order authorisations. Supports bid strategy and stakeholder influence mapping.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; PMO Stakeholder Management Framework

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organisational department or business unit within the client organisation to which the contact belongs (e.g., Engineering, Procurement, Legal, Finance). Supports targeted stakeholder engagement and communication routing.

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates that this contact has opted out of all marketing and non-essential communications, or that a legal restriction prevents outreach. Enforces GDPR Article 21 right to object and CAN-SPAM compliance in Salesforce CRM campaign management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the contact used for official project correspondence, RFI responses, bid submissions, and CRM communication tracking. Sourced from Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: email_opt_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has opted out of email marketing communications specifically. Distinct from do_not_contact which covers all channels. Enforces GDPR consent management and CAN-SPAM compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the individual stakeholder contact as recorded in Salesforce CRM. Used for personalised correspondence and formal communication in client relationship management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Complete display name of the contact (e.g., salutation + first + last name) as stored in Salesforce CRM. Used in formal correspondence, bid submissions, and contract administration documents.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: influence_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–10) representing the contact's level of influence over project award decisions, contract negotiations, and change order approvals. Used in bid strategy and stakeholder mapping for major infrastructure pursuits.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; PMO Stakeholder Management Framework

attributes.name: is_decision_maker
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has final decision-making authority for contract awards, change orders (CO), or project approvals. Critical for bid management and opportunity pipeline qualification in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Management; FIDIC Contract Administration

attributes.name: is_executive_sponsor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact holds the role of executive sponsor for the client relationship. Executive sponsors are senior client representatives who champion the construction partnership at the strategic level.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; PMO Stakeholder Engagement Framework

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the designated primary point of contact for the client account. Only one contact per account should be flagged as primary. Used to route official correspondence and contract notifications.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title or position of the contact within their organisation (e.g., Project Director, Procurement Manager, Chief Engineer). Used to identify the contact's functional role in client engagement and bid management.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent logged activity (call, email, meeting, site visit) with this contact in Salesforce CRM. Used to measure engagement recency and identify at-risk relationships in client retention analytics.

attributes.name: last_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent in-person or virtual meeting held with this contact. Used by account managers to track face-to-face engagement frequency and support relationship health assessments.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; PMO Stakeholder Engagement Framework

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the contact record in the source Salesforce CRM system. Used for incremental data loading, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Logging; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name or surname of the individual stakeholder contact. Combined with first_name to form the full display name used in client-facing communications and CRM reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: linkedin_url
attributes.description: LinkedIn professional profile URL for the contact. Used by business development and account management teams for relationship intelligence, stakeholder research, and pre-bid engagement in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis for Processing); Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile or cell phone number for the contact. Used for urgent site communications, HSE notifications, and out-of-hours contact during critical project milestones.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for account managers to record qualitative observations, relationship context, stakeholder preferences, and strategic notes about the contact. Supports informed client engagement and bid strategy preparation.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the contact, including country and area code. Used for direct communication during project execution, bid clarifications, and contract administration.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's preferred method of communication for project correspondence, meeting invitations, and bid-related notifications. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and used to personalise outreach in opportunity pipeline management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; GDPR Article 7 (Consent)

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code representing the contact's preferred language for written and verbal communication (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'ar', 'zh'). Supports multilingual project environments common in global EPC and infrastructure projects.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; GDPR Article 12 (Transparent Communication)

attributes.name: relationship_health
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the current health of the business relationship with this contact, as evaluated by the account manager or business development team. Used in CRM pipeline forecasting and client retention strategies.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; PMO Stakeholder Engagement Framework

attributes.name: salutation
attributes.description: Formal honorific or title prefix for the contact (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr.) used in official correspondence, contract documents, and client communications.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Origin channel through which this contact was acquired or first identified (e.g., CRM import, referral, industry conference, Request for Proposal (RFP) response, website enquiry, partner introduction). Supports lead source analytics in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Source; PMO Business Development Framework

products.name: jv_structure
products.description: Defines Joint Venture (JV) arrangements where multiple client entities co-sponsor or co-own a construction project. Captures JV name, lead sponsor, participating entities, equity share percentages, JV agreement reference, governing law, JV type (PPP, BOT, consortium), formation date, dissolution date, and JV management structure. Critical for PPP and BOT project delivery models.

attributes.name: jv_structure_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Joint Venture (JV) structure record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary contract under which the JV is engaged. Links the JV structure to the contract administration domain for CO (Change Order), LD (Liquidated Damages), and EOT (Extension of Time) management.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; Procore Contract Administration

attributes.name: client_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associated opportunity record in Salesforce CRM. Links the JV structure to the bid management and pipeline forecasting process, enabling traceability from opportunity to JV formation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Tracking; Internal CRM Governance

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary construction project associated with this JV structure. Links the JV arrangement to the project entity for scheduling, cost control, and EVM (Earned Value Management) reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 Project Systems; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: tender_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.tender. Business justification: JV structures in construction are formed specifically to pursue a named tender. Linking jv_structure to the tender it was established for enables JV governance reporting, bid compliance tracking, and

attributes.name: aconex_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the JV agreement document as registered in the Aconex document management system. Enables direct traceability to the executed legal instrument and associated transmittals.
attributes.references: Aconex Document Management; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: client_segment
attributes.description: Segmentation of the JV's client or owner base. Distinguishes between public-sector (government-funded), private-sector, PPP (Public-Private Partnership), and BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer) arrangements for CRM analytics and opportunity pipeline management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Management; PPP Reference Guide (World Bank)

attributes.name: country_of_operation
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary country where the JV's construction project is being executed. Used for regulatory compliance, HSE reporting, and geographic portfolio analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; ISO 45001; OSHA; EPA; GDPR/Privacy Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the JV structure record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary currency in which the JV's financial obligations, equity contributions, and profit/loss distributions are denominated.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Contractually agreed mechanism for resolving disputes between JV partners. DAB refers to Dispute Adjudication Board as defined under FIDIC contracts. Drives legal strategy and contract administration.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; FIDIC Red/Yellow/Silver Books

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the JV was or is scheduled to be dissolved and wound up. Null if the JV is ongoing. Used for financial reporting, DLP (Defects Liability Period) tracking, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines

attributes.name: dlp_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the DLP (Defects Liability Period) for the JV's project obligations expires. After this date, the JV's liability for defects under the contract ceases. Critical for contract closeout and financial provisioning.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: formation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the JV was formally constituted and the JV agreement became effective. Marks the start of the JV's legal existence and is used for financial reporting under IFRS 11.
attributes.references: IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the jurisdiction whose laws govern the JV agreement and dispute resolution. Critical for cross-border JV arrangements and PPP/BOT projects.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; GDPR/Privacy Regulations

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Specific legal jurisdiction or state/province within the governing law country that applies to the JV agreement (e.g., 'New South Wales', 'Dubai International Financial Centre'). Supplements governing_law_country for sub-national jurisdictions.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the JV structure record is currently active and operational. False indicates the JV has been dissolved, superseded, or administratively deactivated. Used for data filtering in reporting and CRM pipeline views.

attributes.name: is_lead_sponsor_internal
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the lead sponsor of the JV is an internal entity (i.e., Construction itself or one of its subsidiaries) as opposed to an external third-party organisation. Drives internal vs. external reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: jv_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or identifier for the executed JV agreement, as registered in Aconex document management or the contract administration system. Used to trace the legal instrument governing the JV.
attributes.references: Aconex Document Management; FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; ISO 9001

attributes.name: jv_manager_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the designated JV Manager. Used for official correspondence, notifications, and stakeholder communication management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines

attributes.name: jv_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated JV Manager or Managing Director responsible for day-to-day operations and governance of the JV. This is a role-level contact, not a personal identifier.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; SAP SuccessFactors HCM

attributes.name: jv_manager_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number of the designated JV Manager for direct contact. Used for urgent project communications and stakeholder engagement.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines

attributes.name: jv_name
attributes.description: Official registered or trading name of the Joint Venture entity as stated in the JV agreement and used in all project correspondence, bid submissions, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; IBC; ASCE

attributes.name: jv_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier assigned to the JV arrangement, used in contracts, correspondence, and regulatory filings. Sourced from Salesforce CRM or Aconex document management.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; Internal Contract Administration Standard

attributes.name: jv_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or commonly used name for the JV, used in internal reporting, dashboards, and project management systems such as Oracle Primavera P6 and Procore.

attributes.name: jv_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the JV arrangement. 'formation' indicates the JV is being constituted; 'pending' indicates awaiting regulatory or client approval; 'active' indicates fully operational; 'suspended' indicates temporarily halted; 'dissolved' indicates the JV has been wound up.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements

attributes.name: jv_type
attributes.description: Classification of the JV arrangement by delivery model or legal structure. PPP (Public-Private Partnership), BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer), Consortium, Incorporated JV, Unincorporated JV, or EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction) joint venture. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PPP|BOT|Consortium|Incorporated|Unincorporated|EPC — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; PPP Reference Guide (World Bank); IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements

attributes.name: leed_certification_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Target
attributes.description: Target LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification level for the project associated with this JV. Used for sustainability reporting and client commitment tracking.
attributes.references: LEED (U.S. Green Building Council); ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: liability_structure
attributes.description: Legal liability arrangement between JV partners as defined in the JV agreement. 'joint_and_several' means each partner is fully liable; 'several_only' means each partner is liable only for their share. Critical for risk management and contract administration.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; IBC; ASCE

attributes.name: management_structure_type
attributes.description: Type of governance and management structure adopted by the JV. 'board' indicates a formal board of directors; 'management_committee' indicates a joint committee; 'single_manager' indicates one partner manages on behalf of all; 'co_management' indicates shared management responsibilities.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special conditions, or commentary about the JV arrangement that is not captured in structured fields. Used by contract administrators and project managers.

attributes.name: ntp_date
attributes.description: Date on which the NTP (Notice to Proceed) was issued to the JV, authorising commencement of construction works. Marks the official start of the JV's contractual obligations and is used for schedule baseline management in Oracle Primavera P6.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; Oracle Primavera P6 Baseline Management

attributes.name: participant_count
attributes.description: Total number of participating entities (partners or members) in the JV arrangement. Used for governance reporting and to validate completeness of the JV participant roster.
attributes.references: FIDIC Joint Venture Guidelines; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements

attributes.name: profit_sharing_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which profits and losses are distributed among JV participants. 'equity_proportional' aligns P&L distribution with equity share percentages; 'negotiated' indicates a bespoke arrangement defined in the JV agreement.
attributes.references: IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: project_sector
attributes.description: Primary industry sector of the construction project(s) associated with this JV. Used for client segmentation, pipeline forecasting in Salesforce CRM, and portfolio analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: infrastructure|energy|commercial|residential|industrial|transport|water|healthcare|education — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Pipeline Forecasting; ASCE; IBC

attributes.name: registration_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country in which the JV entity is legally registered. May differ from the governing law country for cross-border projects.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official company or entity registration number issued by the relevant government authority for the incorporated JV entity. Applicable for incorporated JV types; null for unincorporated consortia.
attributes.references: IBC; ASCE; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this JV structure record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across Salesforce CRM, Aconex, SAP S/4HANA, and Procore.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: total_committed_capital
attributes.description: Total capital committed by all JV participants as stated in the JV agreement, expressed in the JV's primary currency. Used for financial reporting, EBITDA analysis, and project cost control.
attributes.references: IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: total_equity_pct
attributes.description: Sum of all participating entities' equity share percentages in the JV. Must equal 100.00% for a fully constituted JV. Used as a validation and audit control field.
attributes.references: IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the JV structure record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Data Governance Standard

products.name: address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses associated with client accounts, including registered office, billing address, project site liaison office, and correspondence address. Captures address type, street, city, state/province, postal code, country, GIS coordinates, and address validation status. Supports multi-jurisdiction clients operating across regions.

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each client address record in the Construction data platform. Serves as the primary key for the client_address entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent client account to which this address belongs. Links the address record to the client master in the CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system (Salesforce CRM).

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. Active indicates the address is in current use; inactive means it is no longer used; pending_validation awaits address verification; superseded means it has been replaced by a newer address; undeliverable indicates mail or correspondence has been returned.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Address Management; USPS Address Quality Standards

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classifies the functional purpose of the address. Registered office is the legal domicile; billing is used for invoice delivery; correspondence is the preferred mailing address; project_site_liaison is the on-site contact office for a specific project; head_office and branch_office denote organisational hierarchy locations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: registered_office|billing|correspondence|project_site_liaison|head_office|branch_office — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Address Type; FIDIC Contract Administration

attributes.name: attention_to
attributes.description: Name of the specific individual or department to whom correspondence should be directed at this address (e.g., 'Attn: Contracts Manager' or 'Attn: Finance Department'). Used in formal contract correspondence and RFI (Request for Information) transmittals.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Administration; Aconex Correspondence Management

attributes.name: building_name
attributes.description: Name of the building or complex at this address (e.g., 'Empire State Building', 'One Canada Square', 'Dubai World Trade Centre'). Used for precise address identification in dense urban environments and for formal correspondence headers.
attributes.references: ISO 19160-1 Addressing; Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: Name of the city, town, or municipality in which the address is located. Used for regional client segmentation, jurisdiction determination, and multi-city project coordination.
attributes.references: ISO 19160-1 Addressing; Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the address (e.g., USA, GBR, AUS, ARE). Supports multi-jurisdiction client management across global construction operations including EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) and PPP (Public-Private Partnership) projects.

attributes.name: country_name
attributes.description: Full English name of the country corresponding to the country_code. Stored for display and reporting purposes to avoid repeated lookups against the ISO country reference table.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the data platform. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data governance and GDPR compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this address became or becomes effective for the client. Supports temporal address management, enabling historical address tracking for contract administration and legal notice purposes.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Administration; ISO 8601 Date Format; GDPR Data Accuracy Principle

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this address ceases to be effective for the client. Null indicates the address is currently active with no planned end date. Used for temporal address history management and superseded address tracking.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Administration; ISO 8601 Date Format

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: General email address associated with this address location (e.g., a departmental or office inbox). Used for electronic correspondence, transmittal delivery via Aconex, and formal notice under contract. Distinct from individual contact email addresses.
attributes.references: FIDIC General Conditions of Contract Clause 1.3; GDPR Article 4; RFC 5321 SMTP

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number associated with this address location. Retained for clients and jurisdictions where fax remains a legally recognised method of formal notice delivery under FIDIC contract conditions.
attributes.references: FIDIC General Conditions of Contract Clause 1.3 (Communications); ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: floor_level
attributes.description: Floor or level number within a building at this address (e.g., 'Level 12', 'Ground Floor', 'Basement 2'). Used for precise delivery instructions and visitor access coordination for client site visits.

attributes.name: format_type
attributes.description: Indicates the structural format of the address to support correct rendering and printing. Western follows street-city-state-postal conventions; eastern follows country-specific formats (e.g., Japan, China); po_box is a post office box address; free_form is an unstructured address entry.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Addressing Standard; ISO 19160-1

attributes.name: is_billing_address
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is designated as the billing address for invoice delivery and accounts receivable correspondence. Used by SAP S/4HANA AR (Accounts Receivable) module for invoice routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Accounts Receivable (AR); IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the primary address for the client account. Only one address per client should be flagged as primary at any given time. Used to determine the default address for correspondence and contract documentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Primary Address Flag; FIDIC Contract Administration

attributes.name: is_registered_office
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the legally registered office address of the client entity. Required for contract execution, legal notices under FIDIC conditions, and regulatory compliance filings.
attributes.references: FIDIC General Conditions of Contract; Companies Act (Jurisdiction-Specific); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Legal and regulatory jurisdiction code applicable to this address, combining ISO 3166-1 country code and subdivision code (e.g., US-CA for California, AU-NSW for New South Wales). Used for tax jurisdiction mapping, OSHA/EPA regulatory compliance, and contract law determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision Codes; OSHA Jurisdiction Standards; EPA Regulatory Jurisdiction

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Supports GIS (Geographic Information System) mapping, proximity analysis to active construction sites, and spatial analytics for project planning.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 Geographic Point Location; WGS 84 Geodetic Datum

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including building number, street name, and suite or unit number. Represents the first line of the postal address as used in official correspondence and contract documentation.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; GDPR Article 4; ISO 19160-1 Addressing

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as floor number, building name, industrial estate, or campus identifier. Optional field used when the primary line is insufficient.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; ISO 19160-1 Addressing

attributes.name: line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line used for additional locality or district information, particularly relevant for international clients in regions where addresses require more than two street lines.
attributes.references: ISO 19160-1 Addressing; Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Used in conjunction with latitude for GIS (Geographic Information System) spatial analysis, site proximity calculations, and mapping of client office locations.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 Geographic Point Location; WGS 84 Geodetic Datum

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional address-related notes or delivery instructions (e.g., 'Security clearance required for entry', 'Use rear entrance', 'Deliveries accepted Monday-Friday only'). Supports operational coordination for site visits and document deliveries.
attributes.references: Procore Construction Management; Aconex Document Management

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number associated with this address location. Used for direct contact with the client office at this address for project coordination, site liaison, and contract administration purposes.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 International Telephone Numbering; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: po_box_number
attributes.description: Post Office (PO) Box number for clients who receive correspondence via a PO Box rather than a street address. Common for government agencies, public-sector clients, and clients in regions where PO Box delivery is standard.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the address. Used for mail routing, geographic clustering of clients, and regional analytics. Format varies by country (e.g., 5-digit US ZIP, alphanumeric UK postcode).
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Standard; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: preferred_correspondence_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-2 language code indicating the preferred language for correspondence sent to this address (e.g., 'en' for English, 'fr' for French, 'ar' for Arabic). Supports multilingual client communication in international construction markets.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1/639-2 Language Codes; FIDIC Contract Administration; GDPR Article 12 (Transparent Communication)

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Broad geographic region grouping for the address (e.g., North America, Middle East, Asia Pacific, Europe). Used for regional portfolio reporting, business development segmentation, and PMO (Project Management Office) territory alignment.
attributes.references: UN M.49 Standard for Geographic Regions; Salesforce CRM Territory Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this address record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution when the same client address exists in multiple systems (e.g., Salesforce CRM vs SAP S/4HANA).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA; Procore; Aconex; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system_address_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this address record in the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce CRM Address ID, SAP S/4HANA partner address number). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system deduplication.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Address; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, territory, or region within the country. Used for regulatory jurisdiction mapping, tax compliance, and regional reporting across multi-jurisdiction construction clients.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision Codes; IFRS/GAAP Jurisdictional Reporting

attributes.name: suite_unit_number
attributes.description: Suite, unit, or office number within a building at this address. Provides the final level of address precision for multi-tenant buildings where multiple client offices may occupy the same floor.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Specific tax jurisdiction code for the address as used in SAP S/4HANA tax determination. May differ from the general jurisdiction code in federal/state/local tax overlay scenarios. Used for sales tax, VAT, and withholding tax calculations on client invoices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Determination; IFRS/GAAP Tax Reporting; IBC Tax Jurisdiction

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, Asia/Dubai, Australia/Sydney). Used for scheduling client communications, meeting coordination, and project milestone notifications across global construction operations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change detection, incremental data loading in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail Requirements; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Capture

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the address was last validated against a postal authority or address verification service. Used to schedule re-validation cycles and assess data quality freshness.
attributes.references: USPS Address Validation Standards; ISO 8601 Date Format

attributes.name: validation_source
attributes.description: Name of the service or system used to validate the address (e.g., USPS, Google Maps API, Loqate, SmartyStreets). Provides traceability for data quality audits and vendor management.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Result of the address validation process against a postal authority or third-party address verification service. Validated means the address has been confirmed as deliverable; not_validated means validation has not been attempted; failed means the address could not be verified; partial means only some components were verified.
attributes.references: USPS Address Validation Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42

products.name: client_opportunity
products.description: Pre-award commercial opportunity record tracking potential construction projects in the BD pipeline. Captures opportunity name, client account, project type, estimated contract value, delivery model (EPC, GMP, DBB, PPP), bid/no-bid decision, probability of win, expected NTP date, pipeline stage, BD owner, and win/loss outcome. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Opportunity object. SSOT for pipeline forecasting.

attributes.name: client_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the client opportunity record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the client_opportunity data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account (project owner, developer, or sponsor) associated with this opportunity. Maps to the Salesforce CRM Account object.

attributes.name: bid_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.bid_opportunity. Business justification: Required for Opportunity Alignment Report linking client opportunity to the corresponding bid opportunity to track win/loss and financial exposure.

attributes.name: actual_award_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract was formally awarded. Populated upon win outcome. Used for win/loss analysis and BD cycle time measurement.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity; PMO Contract Administration

attributes.name: bid_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Internal estimate of the cost to prepare and submit the bid (tendering cost), including estimating, engineering, and proposal resources. Used for bid cost tracking and ROI analysis on BD spend.
attributes.references: Viewpoint Vista Job Costing; PMO Bid Cost Management

attributes.name: bid_no_bid_decision
attributes.description: Formal decision outcome from the bid/no-bid review process indicating whether the company will pursue this opportunity. Pending_review indicates the decision gate has not yet been completed.
attributes.references: PMO Bid Governance Framework; Salesforce CRM Opportunity

attributes.name: bid_no_bid_decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal bid/no-bid decision was made and recorded. Used for governance audit trails and BD cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: bid_submission_date
attributes.description: Actual or planned date on which the bid/tender/proposal was or is to be submitted to the client. Critical scheduling milestone for BD and estimating teams.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Close Date; PMO Bid Schedule

attributes.name: bim_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client mandates Building Information Modeling (BIM) as a project delivery requirement. True = BIM is contractually required. Drives technology and resource planning for the bid.

attributes.name: boq_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Bill of Quantities (BOQ) has been issued by the client as part of the tender package. True = BOQ provided; False = lump-sum or design-build without BOQ. Affects estimating approach and bid strategy.
attributes.references: FIDIC Contract Conditions; PMO Estimating Standards

attributes.name: client_opportunity_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the scope, nature, and key characteristics of the construction opportunity. Provides context for BD team members reviewing the pipeline and supports AI/ML-based opportunity classification.

attributes.name: competitor_names
attributes.description: Names of known competing firms bidding on the same opportunity. Free-text or comma-separated list. Confidential competitive intelligence used for bid strategy and market positioning analysis.
attributes.references: PMO Competitive Intelligence Framework; Salesforce CRM Opportunity

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the opportunity record was first created in the source CRM system. Represents the business event of opportunity identification and entry into the BD pipeline. Used for pipeline age and BD cycle time analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity CreatedDate; GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated contract value and weighted pipeline value (e.g., USD, EUR, AED, GBP). Required for multi-currency pipeline consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: Contract delivery model under which the construction project will be executed. EPC = Engineering Procurement and Construction; GMP = Guaranteed Maximum Price; DBB = Design-Bid-Build; DB = Design-Build; PPP = Public-Private Partnership; BOT = Build-Operate-Transfer; FIDIC = FIDIC-based contract. Drives risk allocation and commercial strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EPC|GMP|DBB|DB|PPP|BOT|FIDIC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FIDIC (International Federation of Consulting Engineers); PMO Contract Strategy

attributes.name: esg_requirements
