attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.hse_plan. Business justification: The HSE plan governs all safety requirements for a work front including PTW requirements, SWMS obligations, and induction standards. Site supervisors reference the applicable HSE plan when establishin

attributes.name: package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.package. Business justification: Design packages (IFC packages) define the scope of work issued to a work front. Document control and earned value reporting require tracing which design package governs each work front to confirm all

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_party. Business justification: Each work front is assigned a primary contract party (sub‑contractor or client) for responsibility, invoicing and performance tracking.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_permit. Business justification: Work fronts in environmentally or regulatorily sensitive zones require a specific compliance permit before work commences. Site engineers and compliance officers use this link to verify permit coverag

attributes.name: phase_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.phase. Business justification: Work fronts are executed within project phases. work_front.current_phase is a denormalized plain-text field. Linking to phase enables phase-level work front reporting, mobilization planning per phase,

attributes.name: primary_work_construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent project under which this work front is executed. Enables roll-up of work front data to project-level reporting and earned value computation.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Project Systems; SAP S/4HANA – Project Systems

attributes.name: project_milestone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_milestone. Business justification: Work fronts are tied to contractual milestones (e.g., 'Front 3 concrete complete' triggers payment milestone). Linking work_front to project_milestone enables milestone-driven work front management, L

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_requisition. Business justification: REQUIRED: Work Front material requisition process creates a purchase requisition per front for tracking material needs; experts expect a direct FK.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.risk_assessment. Business justification: HSE plans and project safety management require a risk assessment to be completed and approved before each work front is activated. Construction HSE managers link risk assessments to work fronts for p

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.site. Business justification: A work front belongs to a single construction site; adding work_front.site_id creates the required parent relationship and eliminates site isolation.

attributes.name: subcontract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.subcontract. Business justification: Work fronts are executed under specific subcontract contracts; linking enables schedule, cost and risk integration.

attributes.name: swms_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.swms. Business justification: A SWMS must be in place before any work front commences — this is a mandatory HSE gate in construction. work_front.swms_reference is a denormalized text reference to the SWMS record; replacing it with

attributes.name: technical_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.technical_specification. Business justification: Each work front executes work governed by a technical specification (e.g., concrete placement spec, earthworks compaction spec). Quality ITPs and hold points on a work front are defined by the governi

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element that governs the scope of work executed at this work front. Aligns spatial execution with the project schedule hierarchy.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – WBS; SAP S/4HANA – Project Systems (WBS)

attributes.name: wbs_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.wbs_node. Business justification: Work fronts are physically mapped to schedule WBS nodes for 3-week lookahead planning and earned value reporting. Construction schedulers assign work fronts to WBS nodes to track production against th

attributes.name: access_restriction
attributes.description: The access control classification for this work front. 'permit_required' indicates a Permit to Work (PTW) is mandatory before entry; 'restricted_zone' limits access to authorised personnel; 'exclusion_zone' prohibits all non-essential access. Supports HSE compliance.
attributes.references: Intelex – Permit to Work; OSHA 29 CFR 1926; ISO 45001

attributes.name: actual_crew_size
attributes.description: The actual number of direct labour workers present at this work front on the most recent reporting day. Compared against planned_crew_size to identify under-manning and productivity risks.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Time Tracking; Procore – Daily Logs

attributes.name: actual_production_qty
attributes.description: Cumulative actual production quantity achieved at this work front to date, expressed in the production_unit. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob production tracking and field measurements. Used to compute earned value.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking; EVM Standards (ANSI/EIA-748)

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which work commenced at this work front. Compared against planned_start_date to compute schedule variance. Sourced from Procore daily logs or HCSS HeavyJob time tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Progress Tracking; Procore – Daily Logs

attributes.name: area_sqm
attributes.description: Total plan area of the work front in square metres. Used as the principal quantitative measure of the resource for production rate calculations, crew density planning, and progress measurement.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking; BOQ Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this work front record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 – Record Control; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: demobilization_date
attributes.description: The date on which all resources were demobilized from this work front and active work ceased. Null if the work front is still active. Used to calculate work front duration and close out cost codes.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Baseline Management; HCSS HeavyJob – Equipment Hours

attributes.name: elevation_m
attributes.description: Reference elevation of the work front above mean sea level in metres. Critical for earthworks volume calculations, drainage design, and structural level control.
attributes.references: ASCE 7 – Structural Engineering Standards; Autodesk BIM 360 – 3D Modeling

attributes.name: environmental_sensitivity
attributes.description: Classification of the environmental sensitivity of the work front location. 'sensitive' and 'protected' areas require additional environmental controls and monitoring per ISO 14001 and EPA requirements. 'remediation_required' indicates contaminated ground conditions.
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Regulations; ISO 14001; LEED Construction Activity Pollution Prevention

attributes.name: forecast_finish_date
attributes.description: Current forecast date for completion of all work at this work front, updated based on actual progress and remaining work. Supports look-ahead scheduling and early warning of delays.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Progress Tracking; CPM Scheduling Standards

attributes.name: front_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the work front within the project or site. Used in daily logs, production reports, and cost coding in HCSS HeavyJob and Procore.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Cost Coding; Procore – Daily Logs

attributes.name: front_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the work front (e.g., 'Zone A – Pile Cap Excavation', 'North Abutment Face'). Used in daily logs, progress reports, and field management interfaces.
attributes.references: Procore – Field Management; HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking

attributes.name: front_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the work front. 'mobilizing' indicates resources are being deployed; 'active' indicates concurrent work is in progress; 'suspended' indicates a temporary hold; 'demobilized' indicates resources have been withdrawn; 'completed' indicates all planned work is finished.
attributes.references: Procore – Field Management; HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking

attributes.name: front_type
attributes.description: Classification of the spatial unit represented by this work front. Distinguishes between zone (broad area), area (defined boundary), face (excavation or structural face), sector, corridor, level (floor/elevation), or bay. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: zone|area|face|sector|corridor|level|bay — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking; Procore – Field Management

attributes.name: grid_reference
attributes.description: Site-specific grid reference or chainage notation (e.g., 'Grid E5-F6', 'CH 1+200 to CH 1+450') used in engineering drawings and BIM models to locate the work front. Complements GPS coordinates for internal site navigation.
attributes.references: Autodesk BIM 360 – 3D Modeling; CAD Drawing Standards

attributes.name: heavyjob_cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center identifier in HCSS HeavyJob associated with this work front. Used for field-level cost allocation, equipment hour tracking, and production rate reporting.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Cost Coding; HCSS HeavyJob – Equipment Hours

attributes.name: hse_risk_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Risk Level
attributes.description: The assessed HSE risk level for this work front based on the activities being performed, proximity to hazards, and environmental conditions. Drives frequency of safety inspections and toolbox meetings (TBM) requirements.

attributes.name: is_critical_path
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work front contains activities on the project critical path as determined by the CPM schedule in Oracle Primavera P6. Critical path work fronts receive priority resource allocation and daily progress monitoring.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Activity Planning; CPM Scheduling Standards

attributes.name: is_subcontracted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work at this work front is executed by a subcontractor rather than the general contractor's own workforce. Drives subcontractor management workflows and contract administration processes.
attributes.references: Procore – Change Orders; SAP S/4HANA – Materials Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this work front record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 – Record Control; Databricks Lakehouse – Silver Layer Conventions

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the work front centroid or reference point in decimal degrees (WGS84). Enables spatial aggregation and GIS-based reporting of production and progress data.
attributes.references: Autodesk BIM 360 – Field Management; GIS Standards (WGS84)

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the work front centroid or reference point in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used alongside latitude for spatial mapping and IoT sensor integration.
attributes.references: Autodesk BIM 360 – Field Management; GIS Standards (WGS84)

attributes.name: mobilization_date
attributes.description: The date on which resources (crew, equipment, materials) were first mobilized to this work front and active work commenced. Marks the start of the work front lifecycle for scheduling and cost tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Baseline Management; HCSS HeavyJob – Equipment Hours

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Current physical percent complete of all planned work at this work front, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Sourced from field progress measurements and used as input to earned value computation in the project domain.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Progress Tracking; EVM Standards (ANSI/EIA-748)

attributes.name: planned_crew_size
attributes.description: The planned number of direct labour workers assigned to this work front per shift as defined in the resource-loaded schedule. Used for crew density analysis and productivity benchmarking.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Time Tracking; Oracle Primavera P6 – Resource Assignment

attributes.name: planned_finish_date
attributes.description: Baseline-scheduled finish date for all work activities at this work front as defined in the project schedule. Used for schedule performance index (SPI) calculation and look-ahead planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Baseline Management; EVM Standards (ANSI/EIA-748)

attributes.name: planned_production_qty
attributes.description: Total planned production quantity for this work front expressed in the production_unit. Derived from the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) and used as the budget quantity for earned value computation.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking; BOQ Standards; EVM Standards (ANSI/EIA-748)

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Baseline-scheduled start date for work activities at this work front as defined in the project schedule (Oracle Primavera P6). Used for schedule variance analysis and earned value computation.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 – Baseline Management; EVM Standards (ANSI/EIA-748)

attributes.name: procore_location_reference
attributes.description: The location identifier assigned to this work front in the Procore construction management system. Used to link daily logs, RFIs, submittals, and change orders to the correct spatial location.
attributes.references: Procore – Field Management; Procore – Daily Logs

attributes.name: production_unit
attributes.description: The primary unit of measure used to track production output at this work front (e.g., 'm3' for earthworks, 'LM' for piling, 'm2' for formwork, 'tonnes' for steel erection). Aligns with the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) unit for earned value computation.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Production Tracking; BOQ Standards; EVM Standards (ANSI/EIA-748)

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: The shift working pattern applied at this work front. Determines daily productive hours available for scheduling and cost rate calculations.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob – Time Tracking; SAP SuccessFactors – Workforce Planning

attributes.name: weather_sensitivity
attributes.description: Classification of how sensitive the work activities at this work front are to adverse weather conditions. 'high' sensitivity work fronts (e.g., concrete pours, earthworks) require weather monitoring and contingency planning.
attributes.references: Procore – Daily Logs; ACI 305R (Hot Weather Concreting); ACI 306R (Cold Weather Concreting)

attributes.name: zone_classification
attributes.description: Discipline-based classification of the work front zone indicating the primary trade or engineering discipline active at this location. Supports resource planning and subcontractor assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: civil|structural|mep|architectural|earthworks|piling|finishing|commissioning — promote to reference product]

products.name: daily_log
products.description: Official daily site log (header + line-item structure) capturing all field activities for a given project site and date. The header records weather conditions (temperature, precipitation, wind), site access status, manpower headcount by trade, equipment on site, work performed narrative, superintendent sign-off, and overall site status. Embedded line-item events capture each notable occurrence including delay events, weather stoppages, utility strikes, design holds, access restrictions, and safety observations — each with event type, start/end time, duration, affected work fronts, root cause classification, responsible party, and EOT/cost impact flags. This is the SSOT for all site event data — no separate event entity exists. Sourced from Procore Daily Logs module. Serves as the legal and operational record of site activity and the primary evidence base for delay claims and EOT substantiation.

attributes.name: daily_log_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the daily site log record. Primary key for the daily_log data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.activity. Business justification: Daily Log records activities performed each day; linking to schedule.activity enables daily progress reports and variance analysis.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Daily logs are billed to the governing contract; linking enables cost allocation and compliance reporting per agreement.

attributes.name: drawing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.drawing. Business justification: Daily Log reports reference the specific design drawing used for the day's work; required for progress audit and compliance.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Daily logs must reference the active permit governing that day's work to satisfy HSE audit trails and permit compliance verification.

attributes.name: primary_daily_construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project this daily log belongs to. Links the site log to the master project record for earned value and cost control reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; Procore Daily Logs Module

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.site. Business justification: A daily log is recorded for a specific construction site. Adding site_id to daily_log provides a direct FK to the site master record, enabling site-level aggregation of daily logs without requiring a

attributes.name: wbs_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.wbs_node. Business justification: Daily logs are filed against WBS nodes for schedule performance reporting and earned value measurement. Construction project controls teams aggregate daily log data by WBS node for weekly schedule upd

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the daily log was formally approved by the project manager or designated reviewer. Marks the transition from submitted to approved status in the log lifecycle.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: concrete_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total volume of concrete poured on site for the log date in cubic metres. Critical production metric for structural progress tracking, QA/QC compliance (ITP), and earned value computation. Sourced from Procore and HCSS HeavyJob.
attributes.references: ACI 301 (Specifications for Structural Concrete); ITP (Inspection and Test Plan); HCSS HeavyJob

attributes.name: cost_code
attributes.description: HCSS HeavyJob cost code assigned to the primary work activity recorded in this daily log. Enables direct integration between field production data and job costing in Viewpoint Vista and SAP S/4HANA Project Systems.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob (Cost Coding); Viewpoint Vista (Job Costing); SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: cost_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any event recorded in this daily log has been flagged as having a potential cost impact requiring a Change Order (CO) or variation claim. True triggers cost impact assessment and contract administration workflow.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 13 (Variations); Procore Change Orders; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this daily log record was first created in the system. Audit trail timestamp for data lineage and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 9001 Records Management

attributes.name: direct_labour_count
attributes.description: Number of direct (GC-employed) workers on site for the log date, excluding subcontractor personnel. Used for workforce planning, payroll reconciliation, and labour productivity benchmarking.

attributes.name: earthworks_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total volume of earthworks (cut, fill, or excavation) completed on site for the log date in cubic metres. Key production quantity for earned value computation, BOQ progress measurement, and HCSS HeavyJob production tracking.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob (Production Tracking); EVM (Earned Value Management); BOQ (Bill of Quantities)

attributes.name: eot_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any event recorded in this daily log has been flagged as having a potential Extension of Time (EOT) impact on the project programme. True initiates EOT substantiation documentation under FIDIC Clause 8.4 or applicable contract conditions.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 8.4 (Extension of Time); Procore Daily Logs Module

attributes.name: equipment_count
attributes.description: Total number of major equipment units (plant and machinery) present and operational on site for the log date. Used for equipment utilisation tracking, cost coding in HCSS HeavyJob, and mobilisation/demobilisation records.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob (Equipment Hours); Viewpoint Vista (Equipment Management)

attributes.name: event_count
attributes.description: Total number of embedded line-item events (delay events, weather stoppages, utility strikes, design holds, access restrictions, safety observations) recorded within this daily log header. Supports event density analytics and claim complexity assessment.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; FIDIC Clause 20 (Claims)

attributes.name: has_delay_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more delay events were recorded in the embedded line-item events for this daily log. True triggers downstream delay analysis workflows and EOT claim tracking. Key filter for delay analytics.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 8.4 (Extension of Time); Procore Daily Logs Module

attributes.name: has_safety_observation
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more HSE safety observations or incidents were recorded in the embedded line-item events for this daily log. True triggers integration with Intelex HSE management for incident reporting and corrective action workflows.

attributes.name: hcss_log_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this daily log to the corresponding field operations record in HCSS HeavyJob. Supports production tracking reconciliation and cost code validation between Procore and HCSS.

attributes.name: log_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which this daily site log records field activities. The principal business event date — one log per project site per calendar day. Drives schedule performance and delay analysis.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; FIDIC Clause 8 (Programme)

attributes.name: log_number
attributes.description: Externally-known sequential log number assigned by the construction management system (Procore) for this daily log. Used as the human-readable business identifier in correspondence, delay claims, and EOT substantiation. Format: DL-{ProjectCode}-{Year}-{Sequence}.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; FIDIC Clause 20 (Claims)

attributes.name: log_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the daily log record. Draft indicates in-progress field entry; submitted indicates superintendent sign-off pending review; approved indicates accepted by project management; rejected indicates returned for correction; void indicates cancelled/superseded entry.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: lti_occurred_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Lost Time Injury (LTI) occurred on site on this log date. True triggers mandatory incident reporting to Intelex HSE system, regulatory notification under OSHA, and TRIR (Total Recordable Incident Rate) calculation update.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904 (Injury and Illness Recordkeeping); ISO 45001; Intelex (Incident Reporting); LTI (Lost Time Injury)

attributes.name: ncr_raised_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Non-Conformance Report (NCR) was raised on this log date. True triggers integration with the QA/QC management workflow and requires corrective action documentation per ISO 9001.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 (Non-Conformance); NCR (Non-Conformance Report); Procore Daily Logs Module

attributes.name: overall_site_status
attributes.description: High-level classification of site productivity for the log date. Productive indicates full operations; partially_productive indicates reduced output due to delays or restrictions; non_productive indicates no billable work performed; shutdown indicates planned or emergency site closure.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; EVM (Earned Value Management)

attributes.name: permit_to_work_count
attributes.description: Number of active Permits to Work (PTW) issued and in force on site for the log date. Supports HSE compliance monitoring, Intelex PTW tracking, and regulatory audit evidence for high-risk work activities.
attributes.references: Intelex (Permit to Work); ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147

attributes.name: planned_activities_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text description of the construction activities that were planned for the log date per the project schedule. Compared against work_performed_narrative to identify schedule variances and support look-ahead planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6 (Activity Planning); Procore Daily Logs Module

attributes.name: precipitation_mm
attributes.description: Total rainfall or precipitation recorded at the site in millimetres for the log date. Key metric for weather delay claims, earthworks productivity assessment, and EOT substantiation under FIDIC Clause 8.4.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 8.4 (Extension of Time); Procore Daily Logs Module

attributes.name: procore_log_reference
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this daily log record in the Procore Construction Management platform. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the Silver Layer data product and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; Data Lineage and Audit

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional free-text remarks or notes entered by the superintendent for items not captured in structured fields or the work performed narrative. Provides supplementary context for project management review and legal record completeness.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; FIDIC Clause 20 (Claims)

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Type of work shift recorded in this daily log. Distinguishes day, night, double-shift, or split-shift operations. Relevant for overtime cost tracking, HSE fatigue management, and productivity benchmarking.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob (Time Tracking); ISO 45001 (Fatigue Management); Viewpoint Vista (Payroll)

attributes.name: site_access_status
attributes.description: Operational access status of the construction site for the log date. Closed or restricted access directly impacts productivity and supports delay claim documentation. Partial indicates some work fronts accessible.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 (Site Safety)

attributes.name: subcontractor_count
attributes.description: Number of subcontractor personnel on site for the log date. Supports subcontractor performance monitoring, site coordination, and contract administration.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; HCSS HeavyJob

attributes.name: superintendent_sign_off_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the site superintendent formally signed off and submitted the daily log. Establishes the legal record timestamp for the site activity log. Critical for delay claim and EOT substantiation timelines.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; FIDIC Clause 20.1 (Contractor's Claims); ISO 9001

attributes.name: tbm_conducted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Toolbox Meeting (TBM) was conducted on site for the log date. Mandatory HSE compliance indicator. True confirms daily safety briefing was held per SWMS (Safe Work Method Statement) requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety); OSHA 29 CFR 1926; TBM (Toolbox Meeting); SWMS (Safe Work Method Statement)

attributes.name: temperature_high_c
attributes.description: Highest recorded ambient temperature at the site in degrees Celsius for the log date. Used for concrete pour suitability assessment, HSE heat stress monitoring, and weather delay substantiation.
attributes.references: ACI 305R (Hot Weather Concreting); ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety); Procore Daily Logs Module

attributes.name: temperature_low_c
attributes.description: Lowest recorded ambient temperature at the site in degrees Celsius for the log date. Used for cold weather concreting assessment, frost protection requirements, and weather delay substantiation.
attributes.references: ACI 306R (Cold Weather Concreting); ISO 45001; Procore Daily Logs Module

attributes.name: total_delay_duration_hrs
attributes.description: Aggregate duration in hours of all delay events recorded in the embedded line-item events for this daily log. Used for schedule impact quantification, EOT claim substantiation, and SPI (Schedule Performance Index) computation.
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 8.4 (Extension of Time); EVM (Earned Value Management); Oracle Primavera P6

attributes.name: total_manpower_count
attributes.description: Total number of workers (all trades combined) present on site for the log date. Includes direct labour and subcontractor personnel. Key input for productivity analysis, earned value computation, and labour cost reconciliation against HCSS HeavyJob cost codes.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob (Time Tracking); Procore Daily Logs Module; EVM (Earned Value Management)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this daily log record was last modified. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail for record changes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 9001 Records Management

attributes.name: visitor_count
attributes.description: Number of authorised visitors (client representatives, inspectors, auditors, regulatory officials) on site for the log date. Supports site access management, HSE induction compliance, and client engagement tracking.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 (Site Safety); ISO 45001

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Observed general weather condition at the site for the log date. Used to substantiate weather-related delay claims, EOT applications, and force majeure events under FIDIC contract provisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|partly_cloudy|overcast|rain|heavy_rain|snow|fog|storm|extreme_heat — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FIDIC Clause 8.4 (Extension of Time); Procore Daily Logs Module

attributes.name: wind_speed_kmh
attributes.description: Recorded wind speed at the site in kilometres per hour for the log date. Used to assess crane and elevated work restrictions, HSE compliance, and weather-related work stoppages.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1926.1416 (Crane Safety); ISO 45001; Procore Daily Logs Module

attributes.name: work_performed_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text superintendent narrative describing all construction activities performed on site during the log date. Serves as the primary operational record and legal evidence base for progress claims, delay substantiation, and EOT applications. Sourced from Procore Daily Logs.
attributes.references: Procore Daily Logs Module; FIDIC Clause 20 (Claims); ISO 9001

products.name: production_entry
products.description: Granular production tracking record capturing quantities of work completed per activity, cost code, and work front for a specific date. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob production tracking module. Stores installed quantity, unit of measure, production rate (units/hour), budgeted quantity, percent complete, crew size, equipment hours consumed, and cost code. Feeds earned value computation and progress billing in the project and finance domains.

attributes.name: production_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each granular production tracking record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the production_entry data product.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled activity (Work Breakdown Structure task) against which production quantities are being reported. Sourced from Oracle Primavera P6 activity planning module.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) Standard

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset. Business justification: Production reports require linking installed quantities to the specific equipment used for cost allocation and utilization analysis.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project under which this production entry is recorded. Links production quantities to the project domain for earned value computation.
attributes.references: Oracle Primavera P6; SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: cost_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost code used to classify and track the financial dimension of this production entry. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob cost coding module and aligned with SAP S/4HANA job costing.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob; Viewpoint Vista Job Costing; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the crew or gang assigned to execute the production work for this entry. Links to workforce domain for labor cost and productivity analysis.
attributes.references: HCSS HeavyJob; SAP SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

attributes.name: handover_notes

attributes.name: issues_count

attributes.name: shift_start_timestamp

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift period indicating the operational window. products.name: review
products.description: Transactional record for each formal design review event including internal peer reviews, interdisciplinary checks (IDC), client milestone reviews, and third-party/authority reviews. Captures review type, review date, attendees, design package under review, review stage (30%/60%/90%/IFC), disposition (accepted, conditionally accepted, rejected), and sign-off authority. Contains individual review comments as child records with sequential comment number, category (major/minor/informational), comment text, marked-up reference location, design team response, disposition (accepted, rejected, partially accepted), action owner, and closure status. SSOT for all design review and comment resolution data, supporting design approval workflows, client milestone gate management, and regulatory submission readiness.

attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the change notice on project cost, expressed in the project base currency. Positive values indicate cost increases; negative values indicate savings.

attributes.name: estimated_schedule_impact_days
attributes.description: Estimated number of calendar days by which the project schedule will be extended or accelerated due to this change notice. Positive values indicate delays; negative values indicate acceleration.

attributes.name: implementation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which implementation of the change notice was fully completed and verified.

attributes.name: implementation_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which implementation of the approved change notice commenced on site or in design documentation.

attributes.name: implementation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the physical implementation of the approved change notice in the field or design deliverables.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this change notice record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: originating_cause
attributes.description: Root cause or trigger that necessitated the change notice (client instruction, unforeseen site condition, design error, regulatory requirement, value engineering, constructability improvement).

attributes.name: originator_organization
attributes.description: Organization or company of the individual who initiated the change notice (e.g., client, contractor, subcontractor, consultant).

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level indicating urgency and impact of the change notice on project schedule and operations.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this change notice is driven by or impacts regulatory compliance requirements (building codes, safety standards, environmental regulations).

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the specific regulatory code, standard, or requirement that necessitates or is impacted by this change notice.

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the change notice was formally rejected by the approval authority, if applicable.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the change notice was rejected, including technical, commercial, or procedural justifications.

attributes.name: schedule_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this change notice has an impact on the project schedule or critical path.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Brief descriptive title summarizing the nature of the design or engineering change.

domains.name: procurement
domains.description: Procurement and supply chain domain managing the full source-to-contract lifecycle including RFQ/RFP issuance, vendor evaluation, PO (Purchase Order) creation, MTO (Material Take-Off) data, supplier qualification records, and procurement lead times. Coordinates material delivery schedules with project timelines and manages vendor master data via SAP MM.
domains.references: ISO 9001, SAP MM, Internal Procurement Policy

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all approved and prospective suppliers, subcontractors, and material vendors managed via SAP MM Vendor Master. Captures vendor identity, classification (material supplier, equipment rental, specialist subcontractor), registration status, tax identifiers, payment terms, currency, bank details, geographic coverage, diversity classification (MBE/WBE/DBE), bonding capacity, insurance certificates, and SAP vendor account number. SSOT for vendor identity across the procurement domain.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor record. Primary key for the vendor master data product. System-generated surrogate key used across all procurement and supply chain transactions.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: SAP vendor account number assigned in SAP MM Vendor Master. External business identifier used in purchase orders, invoices, and payment processing. Unique across the ERP system.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: First line of the vendor's registered business address. Typically contains street number and street name. Used for correspondence, legal notices, and payment remittance.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Second line of the vendor's business address. Contains suite, floor, building, or other secondary address information. Nullable if not applicable.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Vendor's reported annual revenue in the vendor's default currency. Used for vendor size classification, capacity assessment, and financial stability evaluation. Typically self-reported or obtained from financial statements.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was approved for procurement transactions following successful completion of prequalification, due diligence, and compliance checks. Nullable for prospective vendors not yet approved.

attributes.name: audit_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent vendor audit. Passed indicates full compliance; passed with conditions indicates minor findings requiring corrective action; failed indicates major non-conformances; not audited indicates no audit has been conducted.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Vendor's bank account number for electronic payment receipt. Highly sensitive financial information used for ACH and wire transfer processing. Encrypted at rest and in transit.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution where the vendor maintains their primary business account for payment receipt. Used for electronic payment processing and wire transfers.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Bank routing number, SWIFT code, or IBAN for the vendor's bank account. Used to route electronic payments to the correct financial institution. Format varies by country and payment network.

attributes.name: bonding_capacity_amount
attributes.description: Maximum bonding capacity available to the vendor in the vendor's default currency. Represents the total value of performance bonds and payment bonds the vendor can secure from their surety. Critical for subcontractor prequalification and large contract awards.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the vendor's registered business address is located. Used for geographic analysis, local sourcing initiatives, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Primary business classification of the vendor based on the type of goods or services provided. Determines procurement workflows, approval hierarchies, and contract templates. Material suppliers provide construction materials; equipment rental provides machinery; specialist subcontractors perform MEP, civil, or structural work; general contractors manage construction execution; professional services include design, engineering, and consulting; utility providers supply power, water, and telecommunications.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the vendor's registered business location. Used for international trade compliance, currency determination, and cross-border procurement regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and vendor relationship tenure analysis. System-generated and immutable.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Credit rating assigned by credit rating agencies (Dun & Bradstreet, Moody's, S&P) reflecting the vendor's financial stability and creditworthiness. Used for vendor risk assessment and payment term determination. NR indicates not rated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: aaa|aa|a|bbb|bb|b|ccc|cc|c|d|nr — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the vendor's default transaction currency. Determines the currency used for purchase orders, invoices, and payments. Used for foreign exchange exposure analysis.

attributes.name: diversity_classification
attributes.description: Diversity certification status for the vendor. MBE (Minority Business Enterprise), WBE (Women Business Enterprise), DBE (Disadvantaged Business Enterprise), SDVOSB (Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business), HUBZone (Historically Underutilized Business Zone). Used for diversity spend reporting and compliance with client diversity requirements.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit DUNS number issued by Dun & Bradstreet for unique identification of business entities. Used for credit checks, vendor risk assessment, and compliance with government contracting requirements.

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: Total number of employees working for the vendor organization. Used for vendor capacity assessment, small business classification, and resource availability evaluation.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Geographic regions or markets where the vendor operates and can provide services. Free-text field listing countries, states, or regions. Used for project-specific vendor selection and logistics planning.

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number for the vendor's current general liability and professional indemnity insurance policy. Used to verify insurance coverage before contract execution and during vendor compliance audits.

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the vendor's current insurance certificate. Monitored to ensure continuous insurance coverage throughout the contract period. Triggers renewal reminders and compliance alerts.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent vendor audit or compliance review. Audits assess quality systems, safety practices, financial controls, and contract compliance. Used to schedule periodic re-audits and maintain vendor qualification status.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the vendor master record. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and synchronization with downstream systems.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred payment method for remitting payment to the vendor. ACH for automated clearing house electronic transfer; wire transfer for same-day international payments; check for traditional paper payments; credit card for small purchases; letter of credit for international trade.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining the payment schedule and discount structure for this vendor. Examples include NET30 (net 30 days), NET60, 2/10NET30 (2% discount if paid within 10 days, otherwise net 30). Drives accounts payable processing and cash flow planning.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the vendor's business address. Used for mail delivery, logistics planning, and geographic segmentation. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this vendor has preferred vendor status. Preferred vendors receive priority consideration for bid invitations, expedited approval processes, and favorable payment terms based on proven performance and strategic relationship.

attributes.name: prequalification_score
attributes.description: Composite score from the vendor prequalification process evaluating financial stability, technical capability, safety record, quality performance, and past project experience. Scale typically 0-100. Used for vendor ranking and bid invitation decisions.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary vendor contact. Used for purchase order transmission, RFQ distribution, invoice queries, and general procurement communication.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the vendor organization. This individual serves as the main point of contact for procurement, contract administration, and operational coordination.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the vendor contact. Used for urgent procurement matters, delivery coordination, and issue resolution. Includes country code and extension where applicable.

attributes.name: quality_certification
attributes.description: Quality management system certifications held by the vendor. Common certifications include ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety). Multiple certifications separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was first registered in the vendor master system. Marks the beginning of the vendor relationship and is used for vendor tenure analysis and anniversary tracking.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region where the vendor is located. Used for tax jurisdiction determination, regional sourcing analysis, and compliance with local content requirements.

attributes.name: suspension_end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date when vendor suspension will be or was lifted. Nullable for indefinite suspensions or vendors that have never been suspended. Used for reinstatement planning and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason for vendor suspension or blocking if vendor_status is suspended or blocked. Examples include quality issues, safety violations, contract breaches, financial instability, or ethical violations. Nullable for active vendors.

attributes.name: suspension_start_date
attributes.description: Date when vendor suspension or blocking became effective. Used to track suspension duration and trigger review processes. Nullable for vendors that have never been suspended.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the vendor. Used for tax reporting, 1099 processing, and compliance with tax regulations. Format varies by jurisdiction (EIN in USA, VAT number in EU, GST number in other regions).

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the vendor organization as registered with tax authorities. Used on contracts, purchase orders, and payment documents. Must match legal registration documents.

attributes.name: vendor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor in the vendor master. Approved vendors can receive purchase orders; prospective vendors are under evaluation; suspended vendors have temporary restrictions; blocked vendors cannot receive new orders; inactive vendors are no longer used; under_review vendors are being re-qualified.

products.name: vendor_qualification
products.description: Supplier pre-qualification and approved vendor list (AVL) records capturing qualification status, financial health assessments, technical capability evaluations, HSE performance ratings, quality certifications (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001), bonding limits, insurance coverage verification, past performance scores, and qualification expiry dates. Tracks the full vendor onboarding and re-qualification lifecycle required before a vendor can receive a PO.

attributes.name: vendor_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor qualification record. Primary key for the vendor qualification entity.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Vendor qualifications in construction are mandated by specific regulatory obligations (HSE regulations, environmental standards). Linking vendor_qualification to the governing regulatory_obligation en

attributes.name: skill_trade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.skill_trade. Business justification: Construction vendor qualification records specify which skill trades a subcontractor is approved to perform. This structured link drives subcontractor selection during workforce planning, bid invitati

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor master record being qualified. Links to the vendor entity in the procurement domain.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor qualification was formally approved and the vendor was added to the AVL (Approved Vendor List).

attributes.name: approved_material_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of material categories the vendor is qualified to supply. Examples include concrete, steel, MEP (Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing) equipment, formwork, aggregates. Aligns with MTO (Material Take-Off) classification.

attributes.name: approved_service_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of service types the vendor is qualified to provide. Examples include earthworks, structural steel erection, electrical installation, HVAC installation, concrete placement, surveying.

attributes.name: bonding_capacity_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for bonding capacity limit. Typically USD for US-based projects.

attributes.name: bonding_capacity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum bonding capacity available from the vendor's surety company. Determines the maximum contract value the vendor can undertake. Critical for GC (General Contractor) and major subcontractor qualifications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor qualification record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for compliance and governance.

attributes.name: financial_health_score
attributes.description: Composite financial health assessment score ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. Based on credit rating, liquidity ratios, debt-to-equity, and financial statement analysis. Minimum threshold typically 60.00 for approval.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Geographic regions or countries where the vendor is qualified to operate. Comma-separated list of ISO 3166 country codes or region names. Important for multi-site and international projects.

attributes.name: hse_performance_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Performance Rating
attributes.description: HSE (Health Safety and Environment) performance rating based on TRIR (Total Recordable Incident Rate), LTI (Lost Time Injury) frequency, safety audit results, and compliance with OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) standards. Critical factor for vendor approval.

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the vendor's insurance certificate. Procurement tracks this to ensure continuous coverage throughout contract execution.

attributes.name: insurance_general_liability_limit
attributes.description: General liability insurance coverage limit. Minimum requirements typically range from $1M to $10M depending on project size and risk profile.

attributes.name: insurance_workers_comp_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether valid workers compensation insurance has been verified. Mandatory for all vendors providing on-site labor per OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) requirements.

attributes.name: iso_14001_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number for ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification.

attributes.name: iso_14001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds valid ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification. Increasingly required for LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) projects and environmentally sensitive sites.

attributes.name: iso_14001_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of ISO 14001 certification. Critical for projects with EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) compliance requirements.

attributes.name: iso_45001_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number for ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System certification.

attributes.name: iso_45001_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds valid ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System certification. Demonstrates commitment to worker safety and HSE (Health Safety and Environment) excellence.

attributes.name: iso_45001_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of ISO 45001 certification. Monitored to ensure ongoing HSE (Health Safety and Environment) compliance.

attributes.name: iso_9001_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number for ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. Used for verification with certification body.

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds valid ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. Often mandatory for critical material suppliers and major subcontractors.

attributes.name: iso_9001_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of ISO 9001 certification. Procurement monitors this to ensure vendors maintain valid certification throughout contract execution.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor qualification record was last updated. Tracks changes to qualification status, scores, certifications, or other attributes.

attributes.name: lti_frequency_rate
attributes.description: LTI (Lost Time Injury) frequency rate calculated as (number of LTIs × 1,000,000) / total hours worked. Measures severity of safety incidents. Target is typically below 1.0 for qualified vendors.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional qualification details, special conditions, limitations, or observations from the assessment process. Used by procurement team for decision support.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of past deliveries completed on or before scheduled date. Critical metric for CPM (Critical Path Method) schedule-sensitive projects. Target is typically above 90.00%.

attributes.name: past_performance_score
attributes.description: Composite past performance score ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. Based on historical project delivery, quality, schedule adherence, cost control, and client satisfaction. Derived from completed project evaluations and NCR (Non-Conformance Report) history.

attributes.name: qualification_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the qualification assessment was conducted. Includes site visits, document reviews, financial analysis, and technical capability evaluation.

attributes.name: qualification_category
attributes.description: Primary category of goods or services the vendor is qualified to supply. MEP (Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing) is a specialized category for building systems contractors.

attributes.name: qualification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor qualification expires and requires renewal. Typically set 1-3 years from start date depending on vendor category and risk profile.

attributes.name: qualification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the vendor qualification record. Externally visible unique reference number used in procurement communications and AVL (Approved Vendor List) documentation.

attributes.name: qualification_start_date
attributes.description: Effective date from which the vendor qualification becomes valid. Vendors can only receive PO (Purchase Order) assignments on or after this date.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor qualification. Approved vendors are eligible for PO (Purchase Order) issuance. Suspended vendors require re-qualification. Expired qualifications require renewal.

attributes.name: qualification_type
attributes.description: Type of qualification process being conducted. Initial for new vendors, renewal for periodic re-assessment, re-qualification for vendors returning after suspension, conditional for limited-scope approval, emergency for urgent project needs.

attributes.name: quality_defect_rate
attributes.description: Historical quality defect rate expressed as percentage of deliverables requiring rework or NCR (Non-Conformance Report) issuance. Lower values indicate better quality performance. Target is typically below 5.00%.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation if the vendor qualification was rejected. Includes specific deficiencies in financial health, technical capability, HSE (Health Safety and Environment) performance, or documentation.

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor qualification was suspended. Suspended vendors cannot receive new PO (Purchase Order) assignments until re-qualified.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason for suspending an approved vendor qualification. Common causes include safety incidents, quality failures, financial distress, contract breaches, or regulatory violations.

attributes.name: technical_capability_score
attributes.description: Assessment score of vendor technical capabilities ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. Evaluates equipment, workforce skills, past project complexity, and technical certifications. Minimum threshold typically 70.00 for complex EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction) projects.

attributes.name: trir_rate
attributes.description: TRIR (Total Recordable Incident Rate) calculated as (number of recordable incidents × 200,000) / total hours worked. Industry benchmark for construction is typically below 3.0. Lower values indicate better safety performance.

products.name: material_catalog
products.description: Authoritative catalog of all procurable materials, equipment components, and consumables managed in SAP MM Material Master. Captures material number, description, material group, base unit of measure, weight, dimensions, hazardous material classification, storage conditions, lead time, minimum order quantity, standard cost, and BIM object reference. SSOT for material identity used across MTO, PO, and goods receipt processes.

attributes.name: material_catalog_id
attributes.description: Primary key for material_catalog

attributes.name: procurement_material_master_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material master record in the procurement catalog. Primary key for the material catalog product.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Regulated materials in construction catalogs (hazardous materials, restricted substances) are governed by specific regulatory obligations (REACH, RoHS, hazmat regulations). Materials managers need thi

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to material.specification. Business justification: The procurement material catalog must reference the engineering material specification for compliance and quality control. material_catalog.specification_reference (plain text) is a denormalized refer

attributes.name: technical_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.technical_specification. Business justification: Material catalog entries in construction are defined by technical specifications (e.g., 'Structural Steel per Spec 05120'). The existing plain-text 'specification_reference' column denormalizes design

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: Inventory classification based on value and consumption frequency. A=High value/critical items requiring tight control, B=Moderate value, C=Low value/high volume items. Drives inventory policy and cycle counting frequency.

attributes.name: alternative_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Secondary unit of measure for materials that can be ordered or issued in multiple units (e.g., cement ordered in bags but tracked in tons). Supports conversion factor calculations.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure for material quantity tracking, ordering, and inventory management. Aligns with industry standards for construction materials (EA=Each, M=Meter, M2=Square Meter, M3=Cubic Meter, KG=Kilogram, TON=Metric Ton). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|M|M2|M3|KG|TON|L|GAL|FT|YD|LB|BAG|BOX|ROLL — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: bim_object_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking the material to its corresponding 3D object in BIM 360 or other BIM platforms. Enables digital twin integration and clash detection during design and construction phases.

attributes.name: cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for standard cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency procurement and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the material is manufactured or sourced. Required for customs compliance, trade regulations, and local content reporting.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the material master record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and master data governance.

attributes.name: customs_tariff_number
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) code for international trade classification. Used for customs clearance, duty calculation, and import/export documentation for cross-border procurement.

attributes.name: dimension_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for length, width, and height dimensions. Typically meters (M) for construction industry standards.

attributes.name: environmental_certification
attributes.description: Environmental sustainability certification held by the material (e.g., LEED certified, FSC certified, Energy Star). Supports green building requirements and sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: gross_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the material including packaging, measured in kilograms. Used for logistics planning, transportation cost calculation, and site delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: UN hazard classification code for hazardous materials (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 8 Corrosives). Required for transportation, storage, and safety data sheet (SDS) compliance.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: hazardous_material_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material is classified as hazardous per OSHA and EPA regulations. Triggers special handling, storage, and HSE (Health Safety and Environment) compliance requirements.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height dimension of the material in meters. Essential for volume calculations and warehouse stacking constraints.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last updated the material master record. Tracks data ownership and change responsibility.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the material master record was last updated. Tracks data currency and supports change management processes.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: Length dimension of the material in meters. Critical for structural materials (beams, pipes, cables) and storage space planning.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary manufacturer or brand for the material. Used for quality assurance, warranty tracking, and approved vendor list (AVL) compliance.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's unique part number or model code for the material. Critical for exact specification matching, warranty claims, and spare parts procurement.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Full textual description of the material, equipment component, or consumable item. Provides detailed specification and identification information for procurement and inventory purposes.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Classification code grouping materials by procurement category (e.g., concrete, steel, MEP equipment, PPE). Used for procurement strategy, vendor assignment, and spend analysis.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the material as defined in SAP MM Material Master. This is the externally-known code used across MTO (Material Take-Off), PO (Purchase Order), and goods receipt processes.

attributes.name: material_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material in the catalog. Controls procurement eligibility and inventory transactions. Blocked materials cannot be ordered; obsolete materials are phased out.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: SAP material type classification defining procurement and inventory control behavior. RAW=Raw Material, SEMI=Semi-Finished, FERT=Finished Product, HAWA=Trading Goods, NLAG=Non-Stock Material, UNBW=Non-Valuated Material, DIEN=Services, VERP=Packaging, HIBE=Operating Supplies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RAW|SEMI|FERT|HAWA|NLAG|UNBW|DIEN|VERP|HIBE — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Smallest quantity that can be ordered from suppliers in base unit of measure. Drives procurement batch sizing and inventory optimization.

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: Weight of the material excluding packaging, measured in kilograms. Used for material quantity verification and yield calculations in construction processes.

attributes.name: procurement_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days from PO (Purchase Order) issuance to material delivery on site. Used for project scheduling, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), and critical path analysis.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether incoming goods receipt requires quality inspection per ITP (Inspection and Test Plan) before acceptance. Triggers QA/QC workflow in goods receipt process.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the material can be stored before expiration or quality degradation. Critical for perishable materials (adhesives, sealants, chemicals) and inventory rotation (FIFO/FEFO).

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Abbreviated description of the material for display in transaction screens, reports, and mobile applications. Limited to 40 characters for operational efficiency.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Baseline unit cost of the material used for project budgeting, cost estimation, and variance analysis. Updated periodically based on procurement history and market conditions.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required environmental conditions for material storage to maintain quality and safety. Drives warehouse zone assignment and inventory handling procedures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ambient|climate_controlled|refrigerated|dry|ventilated|hazmat_certified|outdoor_covered|outdoor_uncovered — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: SAP valuation class code linking material to general ledger (GL) accounts for inventory valuation and cost of goods sold (COGS) posting. Drives financial accounting integration.

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Volumetric measurement of the material in cubic meters. Used for bulk materials (concrete, aggregates) and transportation capacity planning.

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for volume field. Typically cubic meters (M3) for construction bulk materials.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for gross and net weight fields. Typically kilograms (KG) or metric tons (TON) for construction materials.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width dimension of the material in meters. Used for area calculations and storage layout planning.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created the material master record. Supports audit trail and data stewardship accountability.

products.name: rfq
products.description: Request for Quotation records issued to vendors for pricing and availability of materials, equipment, or services, including header-level metadata and granular line-item detail. Captures RFQ number, issuing project, scope description, BOQ reference, submission deadline, bid bond requirement, evaluation criteria, invited vendor list, currency, RFQ status (draft, issued, closed, awarded, cancelled), and individual line items (line number, material/service description, quantity, UoM, required delivery date, site delivery location, technical specification reference, drawing/BIM reference). Sourced from SAP MM RFQ process and Procore bid management workflows. Enables granular vendor pricing comparison at the line-item level.

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Request for Quotation record. Primary key for the RFQ entity.

attributes.name: awarded_vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor to whom the contract or purchase order was awarded following RFQ evaluation. Null if RFQ is not yet awarded or was cancelled.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.account. Business justification: RFQ is issued by a client account; linking enables audit of which client requested each quotation.

attributes.name: construction_project_id

attributes.name: technical_capability_score
attributes.description: Numerical score (0-100) evaluating the vendor's technical competence, equipment availability, workforce skills, past project experience, and ability to meet technical specifications.

domains.name: material
domains.description: Materials management domain tracking inventory, stock levels, material receipts, consumption, transfers between sites, and material traceability (batch/lot tracking for concrete, steel, MEP components). Manages BOQ (Bill of Quantities) reconciliation, material specifications, FAT/SAT records, material conformance certificates, and warehouse operations for construction materials and consumables.

products.name: master
products.description: Authoritative master record for all construction materials and consumables used across projects. Captures material identity, detailed technical specifications (applicable standards — ASTM, BS, ISO, ACI, AISC — grade/class, minimum performance criteria, specification code, specification revision), classification (concrete, steel, MEP components, aggregates, timber, formwork, etc.), unit of measure, approved equivalent substitutes with engineering justification, LEED compliance flags, LEED credit applicability, hazardous material indicators, shelf life, storage requirements, and supplier cross-references. Manages specification lifecycle (draft, approved, superseded) and material qualification status. Records approved substitutions with reason, client/engineer approval reference, cost impact, and affected BOQ lines. This is the SSOT for material identity, technical specifications, and approved substitutes in the construction enterprise — all transactions reference this record.

domains.name: equipment
domains.description: Construction equipment and fleet management domain tracking heavy machinery (cranes, excavators, concrete pumps), tools, generators, and fleet vehicles. Owns asset master data, utilization tracking, maintenance schedules, equipment hours, mobilization/demobilization records, rental vs. owned classification, and asset lifecycle management via SAP PM and HCSS HeavyJob.

products.name: asset
products.description: Core master record for every piece of construction equipment and fleet vehicle owned, long-term leased, or rented by the company. Captures asset identity, classification (crane, excavator, concrete pump, generator, fleet vehicle, small tool), make, model, serial number, year of manufacture, acquisition date, acquisition cost, ownership type (owned/rented/leased), current status (active, idle, under maintenance, disposed), SAP PM equipment number, HCSS HeavyJob asset ID, regulatory compliance class, and asset lifecycle stage. For disposed assets: captures disposal method (sale, auction, scrap, write-off, trade-in), disposal date, disposal proceeds, buyer details, reason for disposal, and authorizing approver. This is the SSOT for all equipment identity and lifecycle data across the enterprise, from commissioning through disposal.

products.name: hours
products.description: Daily or shift-level transactional record of equipment operating hours, idle hours, standby hours, and downtime events captured from HCSS HeavyJob field time tracking. Includes cost code, operator ID, project and WBS reference, fuel consumption, meter reading (odometer or hour meter), shift date, production quantity achieved. For non-productive time: captures downtime start/end timestamps, duration, downtime category (breakdown, awaiting parts, awaiting operator, weather hold, scheduled maintenance), root cause code, resolution action, and impact assessment. Foundational for equipment utilization rate calculation, cost-per-hour analysis, MTTR (Mean Time To Repair), MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures), availability rate reporting, and CPI/SPI reporting under EVM. SSOT for all equipment time and downtime recording. Primary source: HCSS HeavyJob daily time entry.
